/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/Generic:
A simple cocktail of short-chain polymers and contaminants. Easily detected by rudimentary Servofish in the Orb Vallis under all conditions, but ignored by more specialized models. Good for Sapcaddies (found in the lake), and Tinks and Brickies (found in ponds).

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon:

/Lotus/Types/Keys/SacrificeQuest/Sacrifi: A tortured vision sends the Operator on the hunt for a Warframe unlike any other.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/SentientQuest/Sentient: Strange drones have appeared in the Origin System, help the Lotus find out what they are and who sent them.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/SolarisQuest/SolarisQu: Eudico would do anything to keep her people safe, but will she stand up to Nef Anyo?
/Lotus/Types/Keys/SpyQuestKeyChain/SpyQu: Find the thief Maroo and uncover the secrets of the Arcane Codices.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/TauPrequel/TauPrequelQ: Albrecht Entrati's trail leads beyond the Origin System. Only by delving into the past can the path ahead be made clear - but buried secrets can be deadly.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/VorsPrize/VorsPrizeQue:
My Queens, you were right, the Tenno threat is real. We found one drifting near Earth but the Lotus knew we were coming. She purged the Cryo moments before we had them and sent a squad of Tenno to break our assault.

They escaped. We are working on tracing them. Separate this Tenno from the flock and it should be easy to kill. We shattered its Warframe and expect such an abrupt Cryo purge will have damaged its memories.

We anxiously await punishment for failing this task.

- VOR
/Lotus/Types/Keys/WarWithinQuest/WarWith: A disturbance in the Somatic Link prompts the Lotus to send operatives back to the Tenno Reservoir.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/WraithQuest/WraithQues: Void Storms gather in Corpus lanes... could a mysterious vessel somehow be the cause?
/Lotus/Types/Keys/YareliQuest/YareliQues: When tragedy strikes, the Ventkids search for hope in a long-lost story.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/ZarimanQuest/ZarimanQu: From depths beyond reason a Voice had spoken, and its echoes would not be denied. No longer fully concealed by the ever-shifting Void, the Zariman now rests between worlds. A haunting song resounds across the System. It is time for an overdue confrontation with the past...
/Lotus/Types/Keys/DojoKey#desc: Unlocks access to your Clan's Dojo

/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi: Helminth is able to digest all manner of miscellaneous substances, but generates a large surplus of bile in order to do so. Fortunately, this bile can be repurposed.
Plant-based materials of all kinds are processed and liquidized within the Helminth's digestive tract; the surplus is excreted as an inoffensive, inert clump.
On consuming minerals, Helminth converts those it does not fully absorb into a smooth, rich paste with a faint vanilla odor.
Metallic substances, steadily corroded by the Helminth's digestive juices and exuded as a coarse powder.
When Helminth consumes Infested matter it creates greasy intestine-like casings, bloats them with a dark, musky gas and ejects them. The reason for this is unknown and probably best left that way.
Helminth eagerly consumes artificial materials and exudes these rope-like strands of filament as a useful byproduct.

Properly mixed, these will destabilize Fomorian Reactors much faster than their Stable counterparts. This volatile item cannot be simultaneously equipped with Alpha Corruptors. Recommended for Tenno operating as a team.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Circuits#de:
Various electronic components.

Location: Venus, Ceres, and the Kuva Fortress
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/CodaWeaponB:
Harvested from the still beating heart of a Technocyte Coda.

Location: Earned upon Vanquishing a Technocyte Coda in Höllvania.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Concentrate:
A reagent commonly used to produce highly combustible fuel.

Location: Jupiter
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ControlModu:
Autonomy processor for Robotics. A Corpus design.

Location: Europa, Neptune, and the Void
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Cryotic#des:
Usually found in extreme sub-zero environments, Cryotic instantly freezes anything it contacts.

Location: Excavation Missions on Venus, Earth, Phobos, Europa, and Neptune
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Customizati: additional appearance config slot for this item
Unlocks an additional appearance config slot for this item, up to a maximum of 3 extra slots.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DagathAbyss:
The rare thorn of an extinct rose, and a vital component in Orokin Defixios and other technology. Last seen near the Abyssal Zone.

Location: Abyssal Zone on Ceres (requires Abyssal Beacons to access)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DangerRoomK:
Grants access to the Simulacrum.

In the Simulacrum you can face mimeographs of enemies you have fully researched with the Codex.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DataFragmen: Intercepted encrypted fragment of Grineer communications.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DistillPoin: Loid uses devices in Albrecht's Laboratory to reduce Arcanes to Vosfor, a potent powder for alchemical processes. Speak to Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos to trade Vosfor for Arcanes he has stored in the laboratory.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DuviriGuidi: Nearby Duviri Enigmas will be marked with a waypoint.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Eidolonium#:
A gas found solely on the Plains of Eidolon, refined to its purest form. 

Location: Plains of Eidolon Bounties on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Elitium#des:
Awarded by the Arbiters of Hexis to the few Tenno capable of surviving Arbitration.

Location: Arbitration Missions
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Ferrite#des:
Alloy pellets used in Grineer manufacturing.

Location: Mercury, Earth, Lua, Neptune, and the Void
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Fissureum#d:
A magma like liquid that is diluted with coolant during the extraction process. Thermia can be found fracturing the surface of the Orb Vallis during thermal flare-ups. Could this be the key to weakening the Exploiter Orb's defenses?

Location: Thermia Fractures event in the Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensGr: A Greater Lens that channels Affinity into Focus for one of the five Tenno Ways.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensLu: An Eidolon Lens enhanced with resonance from Somatic Fibers.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensOs: An enhanced Greater Lens that has been infused with Breath of the Eidolon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FoilModUnlo:
Turns a conventional mod into a work of art. An Atragraph Mod.

Find Aspirant Zorba on a relay to create Atragraph Mods.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Forma#desc: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaAura#d:
Modifies any slot to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.

*Umbra Polarity not included.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaOmega#: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaStance: Modifies a Stance slot on a melee weapon to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaUmbra#:
Forma that can apply the UMBRA polarity.

This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe or Melee Weapon to UMBRA polarity and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes and Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Gallium#des:
Soft metal used in microelectronics and energy weapons.

Location: Mars and Uranus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GranumBucks: A corrupted decryption key dating back to the founding of the city of Corposium. Millions of these Holokeys were lost to the Void when Parvos Granum's flagship was bombed. Strongly desired by Ergo Glast.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GrnFlameSpe: Used in the construction of Javloks
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/HeavyWeapon:
Allows archwing guns to be deployed in terrestrial zones. Install this device on archwing guns to compensate for atmospheric and gravitational forces not experienced in space.
NOTE: Deployment requires gear obtained from the Profit-Taker mission in Fortuna.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/HekNavCode#: Coordinate used to locate Councilor Vay Hek.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/InfestedAla:
These coordinates can be used to track Mutalist Alad V.

Location: Infestation Outbreaks Invasion Rewards, Hyf and Terrorem (Deimos), and Resource Caches found in Naeglar (Eris) and Formido (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/InstantSalv: This single-use item instantly repairs a damaged component or armament in the Dry Dock.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP:
A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)

A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)

A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)

A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/KahlCreds#d: Chipper's current Stock level. Raise his Stock level by completing Kahl's Break Narmer missions.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/KelaArenaTo:
Points earned through victories in Rathuum.

Obtained from Rathuum Arena missions on Nakki, Yam, and Vodyanoi (Sedna).
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Kuva#desc:
Kuva is an exceedingly rare red fluid coveted by the Grineer Queens. It can be obtained in Kuva Missions, and is used to Cycle Rivens or build rare blueprints.

Location: Kuva Siphon Missions and Taveuni (Kuva Fortress)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan: Chance for each scan with the Synthesis Scanner to count as two scans.
Synthesis Scanner will now show target enemy weaknesses and resistances.
Reduces the time required to scan a target with the Synthesis Scanner.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MechSurviva: Harvested from the debris left by fallen Orphix Sentients, Phasic Cells seem to be key to pulse function. These components can be traded with Father in the Necralisk.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MemoryCrypt:
Neural fibers sampled from an early Warframe prototype and preserved in a stabilized cerebral fluid.

Location: Demolishers on Apollo (Lua), and Conjunction Survival Missions (Lua)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MirageCode#:
This device is used to bypass Orokin encryptions.

Location: Orokin Derelict Vaults on Deimos once opened with a Dragon Key
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ModSlotUnlo: additional mod config slot for this item
Unlocks an additional appearance config slot for this item, up to a maximum of 3 extra slots.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Morphic#des:
An amorphous solid. Possibly Orokin technology.

Location: Mercury, Mars, Phobos, Europa, and Pluto
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MushroomFoo:
This highly reactive mineral deposit is the only substance known to make The Prince grow.

Location: The Deepmines below Fortuna, Venus.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Nanospores#:
Fibrous technocyte tumour. Handle Infested tissue with caution.

Location: Saturn, Neptune, Eris, and Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NarmerBount:
An adaptive Sentient base component responsible for communication flows. Used extensively in the Narmer invasion. A valuable commodity for both The Quills and Vox Solaris.

Location: Narmer Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) and Orb Vallis (Venus)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NavCode#des:
Coordinate used to locate lost ships.

Location: Dropped from Storage Containers
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NeuralSenso:
Implanted neural-link for controlling augmentations. Grineer design.

Location: Jupiter
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Neurode#des:
Biotech sensor organ harvested from Infested entities.

Location: Earth, Lua, Eris, and Deimos

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OmegaIsotop:
Produced by a Fomorian's power core, these particles only appear on or around planets where a Fomorian is present.

Location: When a Balor Fomorian is threatening a Planet's Relay, enemies on that Planet will drop this resource
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCatal: Orokin modification technology used to super-charge weaponry. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCell#:
Ancient energy cell from the Orokin era.

Location: Ceres, Saturn, and Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinReact: Reactor used to super-charge Warframes. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Warframe, Archwing, and Companions.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OxiumAlloy#:
Oxium is a rare lighter than air alloy of Orokin origin, used in certain Corpus Robotics.

Location: Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Neptune, Pluto, Eris, Europa, and Lua.

A disgusting nanite-infested tissue mass.

Location: Phobos, Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, and Eris
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/PolymerBund:
A hard, thermoplastic casing. Manufactured by Corpus.

Location: Mercury, Venus, and Uranus

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/PrimeBucks#: Currency exchanged for Prime components and used to purchase items from the Void Trader.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RazorbackCi:
Excess circuitry disposed of during the Razorback manufacturing process, these components only appear in the vicinity of high level outer-orbit Corpus facilities after a Razorback Armada has been launched.

Location: Corpus Archwing units on Jupiter and Neptune when a Razorback Armada is active
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenFragme:
A fragment of a sundered Riven. It is known that, with enough slivers, Palladino is capable of reforging a complete Riven. Find her in the Iron Wake (Earth) after completing The Chains of Harrow quest.

Location: Eximus units and Requiem Relics
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenIdenti: Use this cipher to instantly complete one Veiled Riven Challenge at the cost of consuming the cipher.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Rubedo#desc:
A jagged crystalline ore. Gives off radiant energy.

Location: Earth, Lua, Phobos, Europa, Pluto, Sedna, and the Void
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Salvage#des:
High value metals collected from war salvage.

Location: Mars, Jupiter, and Sedna
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Salvage1000:
High value metals collected from war salvage.

Location: Mars, Jupiter, and Sedna
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Salvage450T:
High value metals collected from war salvage.

Location: Mars, Jupiter, and Sedna
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Salvage500J:
High value metals collected from war salvage.

Location: Mars, Jupiter, and Sedna
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SalvageRaid:
High value metals collected from war salvage.

Location: Mars, Jupiter, and Sedna
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SchismKey#d:
Raw Orokin memory plasma. Varzia's Foundry can consume Aya to create Void Relics. Find her in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars.

Location: Void Missions and Bounties
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SentientFra:
A shard ripped from a Sentient Anomaly in the Veil Proxima. Little Duck is known to trade these for other exotic goods somewhere in Fortuna on Venus.

Location: Murex ships found in Veil Proxima nodes marked with a special flashing icon (Railjack)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ShrineFragm:
Retrieved from the shores of a sacred fate dream.

Location: Saya's Visions on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini: Mine in peace and avoid alerting nearby enemies with this drill silencing widget.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SpecterPart:

/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraPrime: Khora's will, Venari's fangs and claws.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraKavat: Khora's loyal Kavat. Her constant companion and protector.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Crowd Dispersion' as default Precepts, Wyrm is a highly offensive Sentinel. Wyrm also comes with a laser rifle.
With 'Assault Mode' and 'Molecular Conversion' as default Precepts, Taxon protects its owner with shield restoration. Equipped with the Artax ice-beam.
With 'Revenge' and 'Ghost' as default Precepts, Shade is well suited for stealth gameplay. Shade also comes with a burst laser pistol.

With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle.
A rare jewel of the void. How could anything so beautiful be crafted for stealth?
Both bodyguard and status symbol, the Wyrm Prime Sentinel was the last line of defense for high ranking Tenno in the Orokin Era.
Shade Prime specializes in stealth and comes locked and loaded with the Burst Laser Prime. Together, you can dominate the shadows.
This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.
With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube Prime is the apex of lethal support. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle Prime weapon.
This ornate sentinel is an excellent example of late Orokin craftsmanship and styling.
This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.

With 'Investigator' as its unique Precept and 'Deconstructor' as its weapon, the versatile Helios Sentinel acts as both a lethal guardian and an automatic codex scanner. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
With 'Thumper' and 'Fatal Attraction' as default Precepts, Djinn is a combat Sentinel. Djinn also comes with a poison dart weapon.
With 'Auto Omni' and 'Cordon' as default Precepts, this Sentinel is the ideal companion for long voyages aboard a Railjack.
With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.
With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.
Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/RetrieverKub: A clever accomplice, trained to relieve the enemy of both their weapons and their loot caches.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/HunterKubrow: Bred by the Orokin for combat. This martial beast lives to create chaos and bring down the most fierce opponents.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/GuardKubrowP: A strong guardian focused on protecting its master by bolstering their defense and by driving away attackers.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/FurtiveKubro: A stealthy ally, surprising enemies with impressive takedowns of explosive force.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/ChargerKubro: An experimental blending of Kubrow and Infestation. Uses maggots and other Infested abilities to inflict damage and control the battlefield.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/AdventurerKu: A reliable partner that locates supplies for their Tenno master and while thinning enemy ranks.
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/VampireCatb: Now free of the Vasca virus, these Kavats can transfuse life to extend not only their own health but that of their master.
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/MirrorCatbr: A vicious and deadly Kavat prized for its combat prowess, offering increased critical chance and punishing those that dare attack it.
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/CheshireCat: This sly feline is playful yet devious.

Tiny drones orbit the Warframe or an ally, and intercept enemy fire.
Benevolent Decoy
Creates beacons that draw enemy fire, converting the damage into healing pulses.
Warding Grace
Renders the Warframe and nearby allies immune to Status Effects, while slowing nearby enemies.
Vengeful Rush
All damage taken is transformed into Energy, while abilities gain enhanced Range, Duration and Power. Affects the Warframe and nearby allies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/StealthJetPac: Designed for quick clandestine attacks, the Itzal Archwing excels at striking from the darkness of space.

Launch a tethered hook that either pulls enemies close, or pulls the Warframe toward any stationary objects it hooks onto.
Penumbra

Cosmic Crush
Forms a miniature black hole that sucks in all nearby objects before rupturing in a massive shock wave.
Fighter Escort
Deploys drones that fight alongside the Warframe, each detonating in a destructive blast when killed.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/StandardJetPa: The systems built into this Archwing balance offensive capabilities with defensive countermeasures.

Forms a protective energy shell around the Warframe
Disarray

Seeking Fire

Repel
The Warframe emits a massive pulse of energy, stunning nearby enemies and sending them flying.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/PrimeJetPack/: This enhanced version of the first Archwing prototype takes the design to its theoretical limits.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/DemolitionJet: This heavy duty Archwing was designed for one purpose, destruction.
