Fires a high-yield, remotely detonated explosive projectile capable of latching onto targets.
Core Vent
Vents out the Archwing's propulsion core, confusing enemy projectiles and causing them to detonate.
Thumper
Creates a localized storm of punishing explosions.
Warhead
Launches a plodding missile capable of unleashing a massive explosion.
/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/YinYang#desc: Equinox rises from the edge of day and night. Her Day form offers offensive support while her Night form offers defensive support. She thrives between realms.
/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/YinYang#passiv: |PERCENT|% of Health Orbs are converted into Energy, and |PERCENT|% of Energy Orbs are converted into Health.
/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/Abilities/YinY: Switch forms, temporarily gaining bonus Shields and Armor in Night-Form, or bonus Damage and Speed in Day-Form.
In Night-Form, targets are put to sleep. In Day-Form, targets become more vulnerable to damage.
In Night-Form, reduces damage inflicted by nearby enemies. In Day-Form, increases Ability Strength of nearby allies.

In Night-Form, allies' Shields are replenished with each nearby enemy killed. In Day-Form, enemies are inflicted with <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect. Deactivate while in Night-Form to restore Health and Shields for Equinox and allies. Deactivate while in Day-Form to cast a wave of slashing force.
/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/EquinoxPrime#d: Night and Day in final balance; the graceful perfection of the one that walks the borders.
/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/EquinoxPrime#p: |PERCENT|% of Health Orbs are converted into Energy, and |PERCENT|% of Energy Orbs are converted into Health.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/YareliPrime#des: The Waverider arises, reborn from the ocean foam. In her original Orokin-era splendor she embodies the undying vigor of youth.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/YareliPrime#pas: Yareli gains +|CHANCE|% Critical Chance for Secondary weapons when she has been moving for at least |TIME|s.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/Abilities/Yarel:
Form five water globules that seek out enemies and expand on contact, simultaneously damaging and immobilizing their victims.
Enemies hit by the globules take increased damage from all sources.
Summon Merulina, a rideable creature of the waves, and the inspiration for K-Driving. Merulina protects Yareli by absorbing a large portion of incoming damage.
Tear through foes with a trio of orbiting aquatic blades.
Drag enemies into a crushing maelstrom and then blow them away in a watery burst. Each enemy trapped in the vortex increases the burst's damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/Yareli#desc: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/Yareli#passive: Yareli gains +|CHANCE|% Critical Chance for Secondary weapons when she has been moving for at least |TIME|s.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/Wraith#desc: No longer adrift in the Void, Sevagoth has returned. He and his Shadow deal heavy damage and have high survivability. They are sustained by the reaping of wayward souls.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/Wraith#passive: On death, become Sevagoth's Shadow and fight to resurrect him by collecting the souls needed to rebuild his tombstone.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/Abilities/Wrait: Sevagoth's Shadow flies outward ravaging enemies in his path. Survivors are damaged by Death’s Harvest over time. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.

Plant a death seed in nearby targets to drain their lifeforce. Reap what has been sown to detonate afflicted enemies, dealing a percentage of their health as radial damage. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
Summon a radial pulse wave that ensnares and slows enemies, siphoning their lifeforce for the Death Well. Allies within the wave steal health with each attack.
When the Death Well fills, Sevagoth's Shadow form is ready to be released. Tear the enemy asunder with a collection of melee-focused abilities.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/SevagothPrime#d: The gilded helmsman emerges from the tempest, his shadow a lure for doomed souls.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/SevagothPrime#p: On death, become Sevagoth's Shadow and fight to resurrect him by collecting the souls needed to rebuild his tombstone.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/WispPrime#desc: Wisp Prime’s gilded splendor haunts the battlefield. Allies welcome her interdimensional beauty.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/WispPrime#passive: Flowing between dimensions, Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Abilities/WispRes: Choose and summon a Reservoir filled with Motes that attach to and aid Wisp and her allies. Haste Mote grants increased movement and attack speed. Vitality Mote increases maximum health and heals over time. Shock Mote stuns nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Abilities/WispLig: Cast forward a spectral image of Wisp to confuse and distract enemies. Reactivate to travel to its position. Hold to have the image travel faster and teleport to its position on release.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Abilities/WispHar:
Open a dimensional breach to overwhelm nearby enemies and cause them to release aggressive Surge sparks when damaged.
Wisp may also target a Reservoir to teleport to it and double the range of the surge.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Abilities/WispSun: Open a portal to the sun to irradiate enemies with a devastating beam of pure solar plasma. Hold fire to double Damage at the cost of increased energy consumption. For the duration of an attack enemies damaged by Sol Gate are increasingly more vulnerable to it.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Wisp#desc: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Wisp#passive: Flowing between dimensions, Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/Werewolf#desc: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/Werewolf#pass: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf’s unique Passive power.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/Abilities/Wer:
(TAP) Dynar shrouds Voruna with invisibility and accelerates her speed. Invisibility ends when Voruna attacks. For a short time after invisibility ends, melee attacks have increased Critical Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance and inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects. Melee kill an enemy during this time to extend the melee buff once per cast.

(HOLD) Dynar guards Voruna, increasing her Parkour Velocity.

(TAP) Raksh's fangs tear into your enemies. 5 random Status Effects are applied at 10 Stacks each on an enemy. On target's death, spread the Status Effects to other nearby enemies.

(HOLD) Raksh guards Voruna with Status Effect resistance.

(TAP) Lycath hunts to sustain the pack. Enemies killed by melee attacks drop health orbs and enemies killed by headshots drop energy orbs. Increase the duration of Lycath’s hunt by killing enemies affected by 5 or more Status Effects.

(HOLD) Lycath guards Voruna with increased Heavy Attack efficiency.

(TAP) Voruna drops to all fours and prepares 5 brutal charges that lock onto enemies. Ulfrun, the most powerful wolf, leads the attack as Voruna dashes toward her target. The pack deals increased damage to targets and nearby enemies that are inflicted by Status Effects. Lethal attacks double the damage of Voruna's remaining charges.

(HOLD) Ulfrun guards Voruna. If Voruna falls during this time, Ulfrun dies in her place.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/VorunaPrime#d: Splendor and ferocity reach their savage apex in Voruna Prime. Though exalted by Orokin gold, she is more feral than ever.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/VorunaPrime#p: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf’s unique Passive power.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/VoltPrime#desc: A glorious warrior from the past, Volt Prime features the same abilities as Volt but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/VoltPrime#passive: Grounded movement generates an electrical charge building up |DAMAGE| Damage per meter that is unleashed with the next attack.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/Abilities/ShockAb: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/Abilities/SpeedAb: Embody an electric current. Volt and his allies receive a brief movement speed boost and a reload speed buff.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/Abilities/ShieldA:
Volt deploys an electric shield that blocks enemy fire and adds <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to projectiles.
 
HOLD to equip the shield for mobile cover.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/Abilities/OverLoa: Volt discharges the electricity that courses through him. The shockwave paralyzes and damages nearby enemies. Enemies on the edge of the shockwave are stunned.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/Volt#desc: Electricity flows through Volt. His attacks deal high damage. Enemies will be shocked.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/Volt#passive: Grounded movement generates an electrical charge building up |DAMAGE| Damage per meter that is unleashed with the next attack.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trinity/TrinityPrime#d: Become the bastion that defends allies using powerful healing abilities with Trinity Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trinity/TrinityPrime#p: Allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range gain |BUFF|% of Trinity's Max Energy as Health.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trinity/Abilities/Well: Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trinity/Abilities/Ener: Allies will gain energy over time when enemies are marked with Energy Vampire.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trinity/Abilities/Link: Any damage taken while Link is active will be channeled to a nearby enemy.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trinity/Abilities/Bles: Restore the health and shields of allies within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range while reducing the damage they take from enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trinity/Trinity#desc: Trinity embodies redemption and health. Her extraordinary healing powers support allies. Where others destroy, she restores.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trinity/Trinity#passiv: Allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range gain |BUFF|% of Trinity's Max Energy as Health.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trapper/TrapperPrime#d: Transform the battlefield into a weapon with this gilded tactician. Features unique mod polarities for extended customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trapper/TrapperPrime#p: Deal x|DAMAGE| Damage to incapacitated enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trapper/Abilities/ZapT: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trapper/Abilities/Trap:
Control the battlefield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.
Drop a targeting beacon that calls in a devastating laser artillery strike. Deals doubled damage to enemies with Overguard.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trapper/Abilities/LevT:
Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trapper/Trapper#desc: Vauban is the model of innovative technology. He deploys clever inventions to provide crowd control. His tenacity and focus make him formidable.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trapper/Trapper#passiv: Deal x|DAMAGE| Damage to incapacitated enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Tengu/ZephyrPrime#desc: Take to the skies with this golden bird of destruction.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Tengu/ZephyrPrime#pass: Zephyr moves faster and falls slower while airborne. Also gain |CRIT|% Critical Hit chance with weapons while airborne.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Tengu/Abilities/TailWi: Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Tengu/Abilities/TenguB: Launch a burst of massively dense air. Hold to send enemies flying, tap to pull them toward the burst. Damage increases per enemy hit.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Tengu/Abilities/Turbul: Creates a wind shield around Zephyr, redirecting all incoming projectiles.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Tengu/Abilities/Tornad: Create deadly tornadoes that seek out and engulf enemies. Tornadoes deal the elemental Damage Type they absorb the most. Shoot engulfed enemies to inflict extra damage. Hold for stationary tornadoes or tap for wandering ones.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Tengu/Tengu#desc: Command the power of the wind. Zephyr’s cyclonic abilities protect her, deal high damage, and provide crowd control. She swoops in from above and leaves a path of destruction.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Tengu/Tengu#passive: Zephyr moves faster and falls slower while airborne. Also gain |CRIT|% Critical Hit chance with weapons while airborne.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Temple/Temple#desc: Blazing with glamor and armed with an Infested guitar, Lizzie, Temple’s power chords light the flames of revolution.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Temple/Temple#passive: Play abilities in sync with the Backbeat metronome to invigorate ability effects while increasing Ability Efficiency by |COST|%.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Temple/Abilities/Templ:
Blast targeted enemies with pillars of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage. 

Backbeat Timing: Ignite even more pillars. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.

Drive loudspeakers into epic distortion to create a damaging wave of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while also increasing vulnerability to Critical Chance. 

Backbeat Timing: Doubles Critical Chance. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper’s Wail when it deals damage.

Rip on the guitar to make Temple briefly invulnerable while healing them. Ally’s weapons in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range are lit-up with extra <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage each time an ability is used on the Backbeat and successfully hits enemies.

Backbeat Timing: Invulnerability lasts longer.

Once a charge has been built up on the Backbeat metronome, set Lizzie aflame and torch enemies with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat. While aimed, Lizzie blasts enemies with thunderous elemental sound waves, use ability controls to change the Elemental Damage type.

Backbeat Timing: No Energy consumed.
/Lotus/Powersuits/SiriusOrion/SiriusSuit: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.

Swapping between them grants |EFFICIENCY|% Ability Efficiency for the next |COUNT| casts.

When below 50 energy, Sirius & Orion will steal energy from each other.
/Lotus/Powersuits/SiriusOrion/Abilities/:
Hurl Sirius' Jade Light infused scythe, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while collecting any pickups in its path.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Gravitic Slash.

Sirius conjures Jade Light motes that slowly regenerate over time. Attacking enemies launches the motes, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Astral Shell.

Sirius creates a well of light that heals and revives allies, while reducing incoming damage. The well slowly grows in size and power.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Event Horizon.

Sirius & Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral |DAMAGE_TYPE| damage. Match the star's color to the Warframes color to gain increased Critical Chance.

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius attacks
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion attacks

Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color can be added in a row.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Sentient#desc: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Sentient#pass: Allies within Affinity range gain up to |PCT|% resistance to the types of damage they are currently taking.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Abilities/Sen: Dash forward in a spinning vortex of death. Struck enemies are inflicted with <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect, making them more vulnerable to all other status effects. For each enemy hit, recover a portion of the energy cost, as well as health and shields. Enemies lifted by Sentient Wrath take increased damage.
Smash the ground sending out a radial wave of destruction. Those not killed by the initial blast are helplessly raised into the air, where they take amplified damage for a short time.

Cycle through Sentient unit types, then summon them to Caliban's side. Conculysts focus on raw melee damage. Ortholysts specialize in ranged attacks and inflict <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect. Summulysts summon their own Choralysts and provide shield protection for the squad.

Converge three streams of raw energy upon a single point, causing a massive explosion. The streams strip armor and shields, and each enemy struck detonates on stream convergence. Summoned Conculysts can wield their own mini Fusion Strikes.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/CalibanPrime#: Forged in celebration of the all-too-brief peace between the Orokin and Sentients, Caliban Prime is a true collaborative masterpiece. The heir of twin kingdoms arises in royal gold.
Allies within Affinity range gain up to |PCT|% resistance to the types of damage they are currently taking.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/SarynPrime#desc: A golden blossom conceals deadly nectar. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/SarynPrime#passi: Status Effects inflicted upon enemies last |DURATION|% longer.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/Abilities/Poison: Inflict a target with a pox of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive spores. Spread spores to nearby enemies by destroying them or killing their host. The longer the Spore spreads, its damage will increase.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/Abilities/ShedAb: Shedding her skin like a snake, Saryn leaves a decoy behind to draw fire from enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/Abilities/Weapon: While active, attacks deal additional <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage; this effect is doubled for Melee Strikes. Instantly burst spores when attacking afflicted enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/Abilities/Explos: Release a poisonous miasma that deals <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage to enemies in range. Foes afflicted by spores are more susceptible to the mist.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/Saryn#desc: Toxicity is Saryn’s strength. Her serpentine powers deal heavy damage. For Saryn, venom is a virtue.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/Saryn#passive: Status Effects inflicted upon enemies last |DURATION|% longer.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/Sandman#desc: Inaros commands the fearsome desert. He survives like the ever-shifting sands that empower him. Legend recalls Inaros as the Fear-Eater.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/Sandman#passiv: When Inaros takes lethal damage, he entombs himself in a sarcophagus and incarnates as sand to attack enemies, draining their lifeforce to revive himself.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/Abilities/Sand: Blast enemies with a wave of cursed sand that blinds them and steals their health.
Become a sandstorm. Inaros devours enemies pulled into his whirlwind, healing himself.
Activate to form Armor by draining Inaros' Health. Activate again to stop the formation early. The protective layer reduces incoming Damage and absorbs Status Effects.

Summon a Scarab Swarm to attack enemies with guaranteed <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status. Damage scales with Inaros' Health. Enemies killed while immersed in the swarm summon a Swarm Kavat that fights alongside Inaros and guides the scarabs to other enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/InarosPrime#de: Rise, eternal, to cast the fear of Inaros into them. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/InarosPrime#pa: When Inaros takes lethal damage, he entombs himself in a sarcophagus and incarnates as sand to attack enemies, draining their lifeforce to revive himself.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Runner#desc: Take charge with the Saint of Altra. Gauss is fast, deals high damage, and has strong survivability. Movement charges his powerful battery, so never stop moving.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Runner#passive: Moving generates an electrical current that fills Gauss' battery. Shields recharge up to |SPEED|% faster while the Recharge Delay is up to |DELAY|% shorter, based on the battery level.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Abilities/Runne: Burst into a hyper-sprint bowling over enemies and charging the battery. Crashing into solid objects generates a powerful shockwave. Hold to rush continuously.

Generate armor plating that converts a portion of absorbed Kinetic Damage (Physical, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold, and <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast) into Energy. Also protects Gauss from being staggered or knocked down. Damage Resistance is relative to the battery level.

Siphon kinetic energy from the area, charging the battery and inflicting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status on nearby enemies. Hold reverses the process, draining the battery and inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status on nearby enemies.

Push Gauss' battery beyond the redline, supercharging his Abilities and setting Fire Rate, Attack Speed, Reload Speed, and Casting Speed into overdrive. When past the redline, bolts of arcing electricity dance periodically from Gauss, exploding en masse when the ability is deactivated.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/GaussPrime#desc: Quicksilver takes form. Gauss Prime brooks no talk of defeat.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/GaussPrime#pass: Moving generates an electrical current that fills Gauss' battery. Shields recharge up to |SPEED|% faster while the Recharge Delay is up to |DELAY|% shorter, based on the battery level.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/RhinoPrime#desc: Takes Rhino's ground-shaking abilities to the next level with altered mod polarities that offer greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/RhinoPrime#passi: Emit a shockwave dealing |DAMAGE| damage after landing from a great height.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Abilities/RhinoC: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Abilities/IronSk: Rhino hardens his skin, insulating himself from all damage and gaining Overguard.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Abilities/RhinoR: Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Abilities/RhinoS: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, tumbling enemies around him in stasis.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Rhino#desc: Rhino packs a punch. He boasts high survivability and crowd control. The wise would do well to stand clear when he charges.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Rhino#passive: Emit a shockwave dealing |DAMAGE| damage after landing from a great height.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Revenant/RevenantPrime: The lost one rises. Reify the essence of the Eidolon as you wield Revenant Prime’s power.
Shield depletion smashes enemies within |RADIUS|m with a |DAMAGE| Damage knockdown shockwave.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Revenant/Abilities/Rev: Convert a target into a zealous thrall. Thralls turn on their allies and enthrall through damage. On death, they disintegrate into a damaging pillar of energy. The thrall horde remains under Revenants spell until this ability runs out.
Become enveloped in Sentient energy, redirecting damage and stunning all those who dare attack. Stunned enemies can be Enthralled at no energy cost.
Dash through enemies as a wall of sentient energy, leeching shields and health from any encountered, enhanced for thralls.

Erupt with a multitude of Eidolon energy beams and sweep a circle of death around Revenant. The beams will modify their Damage Type to target select defenses, while incoming damage is redirected back into the beams. Hold fire to boost Status Effects and Damage, at the cost of increased energy consumption. Thralls killed by this ability leave overshield pickups.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Revenant/Revenant#desc: Macabre spectral power has risen. Infused with the essence of the Eidolon, Revenant has strong survivability and deals high damage. Enemies become his thralls.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Revenant/Revenant#pass: Shield depletion smashes enemies within |RADIUS|m with a |DAMAGE| Damage knockdown shockwave.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ranger/Ranger#desc: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ranger/Abilities/Range: Cycle through and shoot one of four tactical arrows. Cloak creates a stationary bubble that cloaks Ivara and allies. Dashwire creates a traversable zipline. Noise emits a high-pitched sound that attracts enemies to it. Sleep temporarily puts nearby enemies into a deep slumber.
Assume control of any projectile launched by Ivara and guide it to the target.
Become invisible and steal loot from unsuspecting enemies or take out prey with deadly headshots.
Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ranger/IvaraPrime#desc: As regal and lethal as a nighttime wood, this is the queen of the hunt in her ultimate form.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/Priest#desc: Achieve redemption through vengeance. The monastic Harrow increases damage to support allies. Defy enemies and ascend.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/Priest#passive:
Overshield capacity doubled.
Start missions at maximum energy.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/Abilities/Pries: Cast a wave of energy that chains them where they stand. Each enemy held reinforces Harrow's shields.
Sacrifice Shields to boost Reload Speed, and Fire Rate while converting damage inflicted on enemies into health for Harrow and nearby allies.

Channel Harrow's energy into the Thurible to generate a buff. Once finished, kill enemies to bestow nearby allies with bursts of energy. The more energy channeled the greater the reward for each kill. Headshots produce extra energy.
Protect nearby allies with an energy force that absorbs all damage and converts it to a Critical Chance bonus for all those under the Covenant. Headshots are amplified even further.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/HarrowPrime#des: The Inquisitor Eternal arises, hallowed by the Void, preaching a gospel of iron and flame.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/HarrowPrime#pas:
Overshield capacity doubled.
Start missions at maximum energy.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/Pirate#desc: Hydroid summons the power of the ocean depths. He provides crowd control with aqueous attacks. His enemies will meet a watery demise.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/Pirate#passive: Enemies damaged by Hydroid are more vulnerable to <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status, with initial Status reducing Armor by |PCT|%.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/Abilities/Canno: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/Abilities/Tidal: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/Abilities/Pirat: Plunder Armor from nearby enemies and increase <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage on your Abilities and weapons. Enemies affected by <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status offer a greater increase.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/Abilities/Krake: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/HydroidPrime#de: Command the ocean's fury with this king of gold and silver. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/HydroidPrime#pa: Enemies damaged by Hydroid are more vulnerable to <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status, with initial Status reducing Armor by |PCT|%.
/Lotus/Powersuits/PaxDuviricus/PaxDuviri: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
Kullervo boasts +|EFFICIENCY|% Heavy Attack Efficiency and +|WINDUP|% Heavy Attack Wind Up Speed on all melee weapons.
/Lotus/Powersuits/PaxDuviricus/Abilities:
(TAP) Kullervo charges a Heavy Attack, then teleports to his target and strikes. His rage-filled focus temporarily increases his Melee Critical Chance.
(HOLD) Teleport to any marked location.

Kullervo surrounds himself with daggers. Each dagger that strikes an enemy restores his health, but each dagger that misses an enemy strikes Kullervo, dealing a bit of damage. When Kullervo has max Health, he receives Overguard from struck enemies.
Kullervo sends forth a curse that binds enemies. When a cursed enemy takes damage from him, every other cursed enemy also suffers a portion of that damage.
The Void answers Kullervo's invocation with a storm of daggers that rain down upon his enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/PaladinPrime#d: Protect the balance with this regal forest guardian. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/PaladinPrime#p: Oberon grants Righteous Negation to himself and his allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range when he collects <HEALTH>Health Orbs, protecting players against the next instance of damage. Stacks up to |STACKS| times.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Abilities/Smit: Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Abilities/Stai: Sanctifies the ground around Oberon, inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage to all enemies within the radius. Also grants protection against Status Effects for Oberon and his allies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Abilities/Rege: Generates a protective aura that grants bonus Armor to Oberon and his allies and restores allies’ Health over time. Healing is doubled while within the radius of Hallowed Ground.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Abilities/Reck: Lifts enemies into the air and then hurls them down with conviction, removing their Armor. Enemies hit by this ability will grant Oberon additional Armor and have a chance to spawn a <HEALTH>Health Orb when they die.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Paladin#desc: Healing and suffering do Oberon’s bidding. His command of the natural world supports allies. Boon to his friends, bane of his foes.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Paladin#passiv: Oberon grants Righteous Negation to himself and his allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range when he collects <HEALTH>Health Orbs, protecting players against the next instance of damage. Stacks up to |STACKS| times.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/Pagemaster#: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.
Noctua scans targets, recording information for your Codex. Status Chance increases by |CHANCE|% on fully scanned targets.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/Abilities/P: Open Noctua, Dante's Exalted Tome, and unleash a tale of woe upon his enemies.
Dante's vitalizing composition grants him and his allies Overguard and restores their Health.
Dante's composition draws blood from nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage upon them.

Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRIUMPH: Two Light Verses cast in succession invigorate allies with a buff that increases Health and grants Overguard. Kills and assists briefly regenerate Overguard.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRAGEDY: Two Dark Verses cast in succession attack enemies. Damage Over Time from Slash, Heat and Toxin Status Effects accumulates in a single blast.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. WORDWARDEN: A Light Verse followed by a Dark Verse supports allies with copies of Noctua. Noctua copies synchronize their attacks with their designated ally’s attacks.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. PAGEFLIGHT: A Dark Verse followed by a Light Verse summons Paragrimms that swoop at enemies, making them vulnerable to Status Chance and Status Damage, as well as drawing enemy attacks away from allies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/Pacifist#desc: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/Pacifist#pass: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to |PERCENT|% more resistant to damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/Abilities/Pac: Dodge all incoming projectiles, but only while not attacking. Use again to deactivate this ability.

A calming wave slows enemies until they fall into a slumber. Enemies woken by damage will be confused and disoriented. Short-term amnesia means all waking enemies forget anything that happened before the lull.
Summon a bevy of orbiting daggers to seek out enemy guns, destroying them with a small explosion. Combine with Elude to double the range.
With his Restraint eroded, Baruuk commands the Desert Wind to deliver powerful radial strikes with his fists and feet. Each moment commanding the storm restores his Restraint.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/BaruukPrime#d: Doomed are the fools who attack the peace and exhaust the restraint of this reluctant warrior.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/BaruukPrime#p: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to |PERCENT|% more resistant to damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Oraxia/Oraxia#desc: Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Fear's name is Oraxia.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Oraxia/Oraxia#passive: Wall Latching grants Predator's Lurk, rendering Oraxia invisible for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Oraxia/Abilities/Oraxi: Leap onto an enemy and pierce them with Oraxia’s spider legs, dealing <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage. Enemies defeated by this attack have a chance to drop Health or Energy Orbs.
Oraxia throws a creeping web to ensnare her prey. Enemies caught within the widening radius are trapped inside a cocoon that increases their Damage Vulnerability.
Oraxia launches a barrage of stinging darts in front of her that applies <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Status Effect. Poisoned enemies spawn Scuttlers when killed.

Unfurl Oraxia's spider legs and go on the prowl. Oraxia is immune to Status Effects and has increased Maximum Health. Ranged Weapons are imbued with <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Damage. Killing enemies causes them to burst with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.

Silken Thread: Tap Dodge to leap to a targeted surface.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/ProteaPrime#de: Behold the child of two fathers. Protea Prime once fulfilled Parvos Granum's vision of a time-wielding guardian. Now she upholds the Tenno ideal of defending the defenseless.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/ProteaPrime#pa: Every |CASTS|th Power Cast is granted +|STRENGTH|% Ability Strength.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/Abilities/Odal:
Throw out grenades in an arc.

(TAP) SHRAPNEL VORTEX
Creates a slashing, staggering swirl of shrapnel.

(HOLD) SHIELD SATELLITES
Protea reconfigures Grenades to work as overcharging shield generators, protecting her, her allies and companions. When Shields break, a Satellite is destroyed to double minimum Shield Gate invincibility time.
Deploys an artillery unit to blast plasma charges at enemies it faces. Each enemy hit increases the power of subsequent plasma attacks.
Deploys a device that generates 3 pickups after a short delay: empowered health orb, universal ammo pack and energy orb.

Drops a Temporal Anchor which, after a short duration, Protea rewinds to trigger a temporal implosion. Implosion damage increases based on damage dealt between anchor drop and rewind. Everything lost or expended in that time is returned.
Dying while Anchor is active rewinds Protea to the anchor, saving her. Protea is knocked down and the anchor vanishes.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/Odalisk#desc: Protea knows all about protection. Her vast arsenal inflicts damage and provides ally support. She can even manipulate time itself.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/Odalisk#passiv: Every |CASTS|th Power Cast is granted +|STRENGTH|% Ability Strength.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Nokko#desc: Spring into action with Nokko! With his strong roots and an array of tricky fungi this young defender will quickly grow on you
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Nokko#passive: Upon receiving fatal damage, Nokko reverts to his Sprodling form and his active mushrooms will glow, reviving Nokko when touched. Orbs spawned will grant a speed boost but not healing. If a glowing mushroom is not reached in time, Nokko will automatically use a self-revive.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Abilities/NokkoT: Throw a mushroom that periodically sheds poisonous spores, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR> Viral Damage and Status Effect upon nearby enemies while also lulling them to sleep.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Abilities/NokkoP: Release a rejuvenating mushroom that emits a radial pulse, giving Nokko and his allies' <ENERGY> Energy and applying a buff to Ability Strength that lasts for a short time.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Abilities/NokkoS: Revert to Sprodling form, spawning orbs that heal Nokko and grant a speed boost. While in this state, Nokko is untargetable and heals gradually.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Abilities/NokkoL: Unleash a chaotic ballistic mushroom that seeks enemies and bounces explosively off whatever it touches. Contact with any of Nokko’s mushrooms invigorates them, doubling their pulse rate.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/Ninja#desc: Behold the patron saint of the Orokin school of political assassination. Ash specializes in stealth. The edge of his blade is sooner felt than seen.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/Ninja#passive: <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects inflicted on enemies do |DAMAGE|% increased damage and last |DURATION|% longer.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/Abilities/Glaive: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/Abilities/SmokeS: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/Abilities/Telepo: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/Abilities/NinjaS: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/AshPrime#desc: Distraction and subterfuge become lethal weapons with Ash Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/AshPrime#passive: <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effects inflicted on enemies do |DAMAGE|% increased damage and last |DURATION|% longer.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nezha/NezhaPrime#desc: Behold: the Scion of the Burning Wind, now before you in most courtly accoutrement. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nezha/Abilities/NezhaT: Blaze a trail of flames, scorching enemies and cleansing allies. Teleporting blasts the landing area with a ring of fire.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nezha/Abilities/NezhaR: Hurl a flaming ring that sets enemies ablaze making them vulnerable to any damage. Flaming enemies drop Restorative Orbs on death. Charge to amplify the power of the ring, and reactivate to instantly travel to the ring's location.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nezha/Abilities/NezhaS: Create a protective ring of fire, that also stuns and damages enemies who get too close.
Impale nearby enemies on spears that erupt from the below. Activate again to slam surviving enemies back into the ground.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nezha/Nezha#desc: The mercurial firemonger protects the innocent. Nezha’s multifaceted tactics give him high survivability as he inflicts damage and provides crowd control. His fire is the clarion of hope.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/NekrosPrime#desc: Death's new master. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/NekrosPrime#pass: Restore |HEALTH| Health with every enemy death within |RADIUS|m.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/Abilities/SoulPu: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/Abilities/Terror: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/Abilities/Search: Forces fallen enemies around you to drop additional loot.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/Abilities/CloneT: Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/Necro#desc: There is a reaper whose name is Nekros. He provides deathly crowd control. Erstwhile enemies become allies when Nekros calls up recruits from the dead.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/Necro#passive: Restore |HEALTH| Health with every enemy death within |RADIUS|m.
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/WukongPrime: The trickster-warrior ascends to his ultimate incarnation.
After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/Abilities/M:
Shedding part of himself, Wukong creates a twin to fight by his side. Attack at range and the twin will melee, pull a blade and the twin will lay down covering fire.
Use again to command the twin to attack a target with increased damage.
Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield, dazing any enemies encountered, while healing Wukong and his twin.

Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.
Summon the iron staff and unleash fury.
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/MonkeyKing#: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.
After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Magician#desc: Master the rift between shadow and substance. Limbo disrupts time-space to provide crowd control. He is at home where others struggle with what is real.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Magician#pass: Dodge to enter and exit the Rift. Entering leaves behind a small Rift portal lasting |DURATION|s. Energy slowly recharges in the Rift, and each enemy killed in there also gives |ENERGY| Energy.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Abilities/Ban: Casts a wave of Rift energy that damages hostiles while pushing enemies and allies out of Limbo's current plane of existence.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Abilities/Mag: Freezes Rift-bound enemies. While active, enemy projectiles are arrested in mid-air, resuming its trajectory when stasis ends.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Abilities/Vol: Surges nearby Rift-bound enemies with Rift energy. When killed the Rift Surge is transferred to a nearby enemy outside the rift. Surged enemies that leave the Rift perform a radial Banish.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Abilities/Tea: A violent blast of Void energy tears open a pocket of rift plane which can sustain itself for a short period before collapsing in another lethal blast.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/LimboPrime#de: Dance between realms with this golden rift walker. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/LimboPrime#pa: Dodge to enter and exit the Rift. Entering leaves behind a small Rift portal lasting |DURATION|s. Energy slowly recharges in the Rift, and each enemy killed in there also gives |ENERGY| Energy.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/MagPrime#desc: The exquisite Mag Prime offers the same abilities as Mag but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/MagPrime#passive: Nearby items gravitate toward Mag for easy collection.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Abilities/PullAbil: Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Abilities/BulletAt:
(TAP) Enclose a target in a magnetic field that ensnares nearby enemies and deals damage over time. The field pulls Polarize Shards that orbited Mag and shrapnel into the deadly mix.
(HOLD) Mag surrounds herself in a magnetic field that absorbs ranged attacks and reflects damage back in a destructive cone.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Abilities/ShieldRe: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and armor as it restores ally shields. Debris left over from the pulse becomes Polarize Shards. Nearby Polarize Shards orbit Mag and cut enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Abilities/CrushAbi: Magnetize the bones of nearby enemies, causing them to collapse upon themselves.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Mag#desc: Take down your enemies with magnetic force. Mag alters magnetic fields to provide crowd control and strip enemy defenses. Few can resist her attraction or her repulsion.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Mag#passive: Nearby items gravitate toward Mag for easy collection.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/LokiPrime#desc: Confuse, deceive and destroy with Loki Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/LokiPrime#passive: Able to hang from walls |MULT|x longer than normal.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/Abilities/DecoyAb: Loki deploys a holographic copy of himself that draws enemy fire. The decoy gains health and shield based on enemies nearby.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/Abilities/Invisib: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/Abilities/SwitchT: Loki instantaneously swaps positions with a target, confusing the enemy.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/Abilities/RadialD: Lets forth a wave of energy, disrupting the projectile weapons of enemies in range and forcing them to revert to melee combat.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/Loki#desc: Loki knows the art of deception. The trickster employs stealth to sabotage enemies. Sow confusion.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/Loki#passive: Able to hang from walls |MULT|x longer than normal.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Koumei/Koumei#desc: Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Koumei/Koumei#passive: Every |DURATION| seconds, one of Koumei's weapons will inflict random Status Effects for |DURATION| seconds.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Koumei/Abilities/Koume:
Weave the threads of destiny. Enemies who touch the threads suffer a random Elemental Status Effect.

A roll of triple sixes creates threads that inflict one of every Elemental Status Effect.

Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Complete the challenge to earn a Decree. Unlucky rolls add a debuff, but you can hold the ability to reject the Omikuji.

A roll of triple sixes grants a Decree without a challenge.

Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei's dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.

Wield your foe’s fate threads like the strings of marionettes. Koumei’s dice determine how many Status Effects foes in front of Koumei will suffer.

A roll of triple sixes causes further Status Effects over time and extends Bunraku to enemies behind Koumei.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/KhoraPrime#desc: A harmony of mistress and monster. The gilded huntress and her loyal Kavat, Venari, dominate the battlefield with their will.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/KhoraPrime#passi: The ferocious kavat, Venari, fights by Khora's side and provides her with a |SPEED|% speed boost while active. If killed, Venari will reappear after |RESPAWN|s.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Abilities/KhoraC: Send enemies reeling with a deafening whipcrack. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Whipclaw.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Abilities/KhoraT: Bind a hapless target in living metal, entangling others who stray too close. Whipclaw will refresh the trap allowing it to capture more enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Abilities/KhoraK: Command Venari to focus on a target. Hold to cycle between Attack, Protect, and Heal postures. If Venari is killed, use this ability to revive her instantly.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Abilities/KhoraC: Weave a dome of living chain that ensnares and strangles any enemy within, and any foolish enough to approach. Foes outside the trap will try to hasten their comrade's deaths by shooting them. Crack Whipclaw on the dome to further damage any trapped enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Khora#desc: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Khora#passive: The ferocious kavat, Venari, fights by Khora's side and provides her with a |SPEED|% speed boost while active. If killed, Venari will reappear after |RESPAWN|s.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/NyxPrime#desc: Infiltrate the minds of your enemies with Nyx Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/NyxPrime#passive: Nyx gains +|CRITICAL|% Critical Chance on Primary and Secondary weapons per Confused enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range, up to +|MAX|%.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/Abilities/MindCon: Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/Abilities/DaggerA: Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/Abilities/ChaosAb: Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/Abilities/SelfBul: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/Jade#desc: Psychic attacks make Nyx a dangerous foe. She reaches into enemy consciousness to provide crowd control and turn their attacks back on them. Such manipulation can turn the tide of battle.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/Jade#passive: Nyx gains +|CRITICAL|% Critical Chance on Primary and Secondary weapons per Confused enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range, up to +|MAX|%.
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFramePri: Hildryn Prime proves that power is discipline’s reward.
Hildryn's full Shield Gate is high. After her Shields are depleted, she is invulnerable to damage up to 3.5s.
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/Abilities/Ir: Charge and launch devastating bolts of electricity.
Pillage a percentage of Shields and Armor of nearby enemies to replenish Hildryn's own Shields and Overshields. Also removes Status Effects from Hildryn and her allies.
Create a shield aura around allies. Enemies that approach Hildryn will take <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage.

Take the skies and rain Balefire rockets down on the enemy. Nearby enemies are blasted into the air where they will create an Energy Orb every few seconds. When shields run out the enemies are smashed into the ground.
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFrame#de: Strength is Hildryn’s virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFrame#pa: Hildryn's full Shield Gate is high. After her Shields are depleted, she is invulnerable to damage up to 3.5s.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Inkblot#desc: Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Inkblot#passiv: INKBLOT: Follie's abilities coat enemies in ink that slows their movement by |SLOW|% for |DURATION|s. Afflicted enemies have a |CHANCE|% chance to drop Health and Energy Orbs.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Abilities/InkF: Drop through an inky frame and emerge invulnerable at the aimed location in a splash of ink that inflicts Inkblot on nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Abilities/InkS:
Bring shadowgraphs from Follie's sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created.

HOLD to open the Shadowgraph gear wheel.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Abilities/InkC: Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Abilities/InkB: Tie nearby enemies to floating balloons that douse them with Inkblot. Pop the balloons to send them crashing to the ground, splashing damage on nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Infestatio: Mutation is endless. The ravening plague-bearer returns in a long-unseen form, seething with a primal strain of the Infestation.
If Nidus is killed with at least |STACKS| stacks of Mutation, those |STACKS| stacks are consumed; this grants |DURATION|s of invulnerability and restores Health to |HEAL|%.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Abilities/: Rupture the ground with a damaging fungal growth that steals energy from each enemy it strikes. For every five enemies hit, the Infestation mutates, multiplying its destructive force.
Spawn an Infested pod that erupts with tendrils, latches onto nearby enemies and pulls them in. Enemies killed while held have a chance of generating a Mutation stack.
Bind to a target with parasitic link. When cast on an ally, both the host and Nidus have their Ability Strength and Weapon Damage increased. Linked enemies take some of the damage inflicted on Nidus.
Gluttonous maggots swarm nearby enemies, feasting until they are hit with Virulence and burst with Infestation. The maggots benefit from Mutation and each enemy hit adds to the Mutation stack.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Infestatio: Nidus draws strength from the Infestation. It bolsters him with survivability as he deals high damage and provides crowd control. Plague your enemies.
If Nidus is killed with at least |STACKS| stacks of Mutation, those |STACKS| stacks are consumed; this grants |DURATION|s of invulnerability and restores Health to |HEAL|%.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/StyanaxPrime#d: Shield of the innocent. Spear of justice. Styanax Prime holds the line in defiance of tyranny.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/StyanaxPrime#p: Styanax's critical chance increases with his shields and doubles for spearguns.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/Abilities/Hopl: Throw an Axios Javelin. When the javelin impales an enemy against a wall, surrounding enemies are pulled into the area and suffer a burst of damage.
Summon Tharros, the shield of Styanax. Swing Tharros to repel enemies and reduce their shields and armor. Styanax regenerates health for every enemy struck.

Draw enemy attention to Styanax. His resolve uplifts him and nearby allies, regenerating the squad's energy over time. Styanax and his allies also regenerate shields for every kill assist they contribute.
Exude might and valor. Rise into the air and throw a barrage of Axios Javelins. The javelins deal damage to nearby enemies wherever they land. Direct hits to enemies deal greater damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/Hoplite#desc: Styanax never wonders how many enemies he will face, only where he can find them. The hoplite deals high damage. Enemies tremble before his spear and shield.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/Hoplite#passiv: Styanax's critical chance increases with his shields and doubles for spearguns.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/MiragePrime#: Dazzle the opposition with this golden master of illusion and mayhem. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
Sliding lasts |DURATION|% longer and acrobatic maneuvers are |SPEED|% faster.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Abilities/Il: Mirage creates an entourage of doppelgangers to confuse and distract the enemy.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Abilities/Ha: Booby trap nearby objects while conjuring an irresistible jewel that bursts with radial blind when touched in darkness, or a radial explosion in light. Conjure multiple smaller jewels with the help of Hall of Mirrors.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Abilities/Li:
(TAP) Temporarily reduce the damage Mirage takes from enemies.
(HOLD) Temporarily increase Mirage's weapon damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Abilities/Pr: Fires an energy prism that shoots lasers in all directions. Activating again detonates the prism, blinding nearby foes.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Harlequin#de: Mirage’s sleight of hand complements her might. Her dazzled foes take heavy damage. Doppelgangers, lasers, and traps are elements of her stagecraft.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Harlequin#pa: Sliding lasts |DURATION|% longer and acrobatic maneuvers are |SPEED|% faster.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/GyrePrime#desc: Gilded circuits spark and energize frenetic movements that echo through the ages. Dance into eternity with Gyre Prime.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/GyrePrime#passive: Gyre's abilities have a 10% chance to deal critical damage for each Electrical status that affects the enemy.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/Abilities/GyrePul: Launch a Gyratory Sphere that will deal high damage on impact and periodically deal electrical shocks to nearby enemies. Hit multiple enemies at once with the initial launch to enhance damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/Abilities/GyreSph: Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after a few seconds or can be manually triggered.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/Abilities/GyreEne: Gain a brief burst of increased Critical Chance and Energy Regen, with each kill extending duration of Cathode Grace. Casting is on a cooldown.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/Abilities/GyreOve: Gyre’s mechanisms spin at incredible speeds, generating an Electric Field that shocks nearby enemies. When Gyre gets a critical hit, a large electrical discharge will chain from the enemy that was hit to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/Gyre#desc: Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters. Gyre’s electric attacks provide crowd control. She is the embodiment of elegant theory.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/Gyre#passive: Gyre's abilities have a 10% chance to deal critical damage for each Electrical status that affects the enemy.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Glass#desc: Enemies are made fragile by Gara’s deadly touch. Gara’s vitric abilities provide her and her allies with survivability and deal high damage. Shatter the foe.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Glass#passive: A chance to create a radial blind lasting |DURATION|s when Gara casts Abilities.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Abilities/GlassS: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Shattered Lash.
Gara's armor splinters into a maelstrom of shattered glass. Allies who contact the cloud are fortified against damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Abilities/GlassF: Trap enemies in a carousel of mirrors, forcing them to attack visions of their true selves. Destroyed mirrors damage their attackers, as does the collapse of the carousel.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Abilities/GlassR: Create an expanding ring of molten glass that slowly crystallizes enemies who enter. When the expansion is complete, the ring hardens to block weapons fire. The ring draws extra strength from the health and shields of crystallized enemies. Use Shattered Lash to smash the ring and send razor-sharp glass flying.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraPrime#desc: Continue the legend of the glass-armored warrior Gara. Dominate the battlefield with the power and purity of crystal.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraPrime#passiv: A chance to create a radial blind lasting |DURATION|s when Gara casts Abilities.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Geode#desc: Gaze upon the Crystal Bastion. Citrine's crystalline might supports allies on the battlefield. Combat only enhances her fractal beauty.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Geode#passive: Citrine grants nearby allies |BASE| health regeneration per second. Pick up a Health Orb to increase regeneration by |HPS|, up to a maximum of |MAX|.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Abilities/GeodeS: Slash and stagger enemies with a crystal blast that inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Enemies afflicted with this Status Effect have an increased chance of dropping Health and Energy Orbs.
Citrine guards herself and nearby allies with a crystalline shell that gradually decays. Kills and assists increase the defensive power of the shell.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Abilities/GeodeC: Deploy a gem that shoots prismatic beams. The gem targets enemies that are taking weapon damage from Citrine and her allies. Its beams inflict Heat, Cold, Toxin, and Electricity Status Effects. Status Chance and Status Duration increase for nearby allies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Abilities/GeodeG: Citrine summons crystal fractals. The fractals rush forward, seeking enemies. Enemies touched by the fractals are paralyzed by crystalline growths. Hit the growths to deal Critical Damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaPrime#des: White, gold and deepest scarlet, the queen of gore in full regalia.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaPrime#pas:
Garuda's damage temporarily increases with each enemy she kills, to a maximum of |DAMAGE|%. 
Slashes with her talons if no melee weapon is equipped.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/Abilities/Garud: Rip the life force from an enemy and use it as a shield that captures damage, this kills significantly weakened enemies instantly. Charge to channel the captured damage into an explosive projectile.
Impale an enemy on an altar of talons and siphon health for Garuda and her allies.
Garuda sacrifices her health to generate energy and clear Status Effects.
Charge to expand the targeting area, release to send Garuda's talons careening toward each target in area. Surviving enemies are prone to <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/Garuda#desc: Death’s crimson maiden sharpens her talons. Garuda weaponizes the blood of her foes to deal high damage. Sanguine beauty complements her deadly power.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/Garuda#passive:
Garuda's damage temporarily increases with each enemy she kills, to a maximum of |DAMAGE|%. 
Slashes with her talons if no melee weapon is equipped.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/Frumentar: Move like a shadow, strike with force. The Orokin created a Warframe that marries damage and stealth to eliminate sensitive problems, but he disappeared in the chaos of their demise. All that remains is a batch name: Cyte-09.
Weak Point Kills increase Cyte-09's Weak Point Critical Chance by |INCREASE|% up to |CAP|% for the duration of the current mission.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/Abilities: Plant an antenna that projects a forward wave scan. Detected enemies take increased Weak Point Damage, and become visible through walls. Weapons gain Punch through.

Throw two Elemental Ammo Packs that instantly refill the active weapon’s magazine, while granting the weapon an additional instance of the selected Elemental Damage and Status Effect. Reload clears the effect. Sniper Rifles gain extra damage.

Hold the ability to select the Elemental Damage type.
Jump backwards and become invisible for a short duration. Killing enemies on their Weak Points extends the duration and heals Cyte-09.

Summon the Neutralizer, Cyte-09’s exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold grenade that completely freezes enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/FrostPrime#desc: Frost Prime has the same chilling abilities as Frost but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/FrostPrime#passi: Cold Status Effects from Frost's Abilities last |DURATION|% longer. Frost gains |ARMOR| Armor for each enemy afflicted with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Abilities/Icicle: A frigid energy blast that freezes targets in their tracks.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Abilities/IceSpi: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Abilities/IceShi: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Abilities/Avalan: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Frost#desc: When Frost steps onto the battlefield, enemies experience a chill. Frost’s attacks control crowds, protect objectives, and increase survivability. Wield the biting cold.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Frost#passive: Cold Status Effects from Frost's Abilities last |DURATION|% longer. Frost gains |ARMOR| Armor for each enemy afflicted with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/TitaniaPrime#des: Tempting and terrifying, this is Titania in her ultimate form.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/TitaniaPrime#pas: Titania generates Health for herself and nearby allies every time she casts an Ability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/Abilities/FairyD: Enemies fumble their weapons as they are whisked into the air. Nearby allies become immune to Status Effects. Hold the ability to cast the immunity onto Titania.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/Abilities/FairyS: Cycle through and extract one of the four Buffs when cast on an enemy. Thorns reduces incoming damage. Dust degrades enemy accuracy. Full Moon increases companion damage. Entangle slows enemies within range.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/Abilities/FairyL: Create a swarm of razorflies that transform an enemy into an irresistible floating beacon, attracting witless comrades before exploding on command.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/Abilities/FairyF: Shrink down and take flight, while razorflies attack nearby enemies and amplify the damage they take.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/Fairy#desc: Titania’s fairy-like appearance belies her formidable regal power. The enchantress deals high damage and provides crowd control. She forces opponents to pay homage or perish.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/Fairy#passive: Titania generates Health for herself and nearby allies every time she casts an Ability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/ExcaliburUmb: From the shadow of the long night emerges a new Excalibur.
Umbra exhibits sentience in combat without Transference control. Attacks |SPEED|% faster and deals |DAMAGE|% more damage while wielding swords.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/Abilities/Um: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
Let out ferocious howl that stuns nearby enemies and causes Sentients to shed any built up resistances.
Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/ExcaliburPri: Excalibur Prime is the epitome of mobility and offense, and features the same abilities as Excalibur, but has unique mod polarities installed allowing for greater customization.
Excalibur Prime deals |DAMAGE|% increased damage and attacks |SPEED|% faster when wielding swords.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/Abilities/Sl: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/Abilities/Ra: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.
Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/Abilities/Sw: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/Excalibur#de: Excalibur epitomizes the warrior spirit. His master swordsmanship deals high damage. He is the embodiment of martial excellence.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/Excalibur#pa: Excalibur deals |DAMAGE|% increased damage and attacks |SPEED|% faster when wielding swords.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/EmberPrime#desc: Ember Prime offers the same potential for wanton destruction as Ember but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/EmberPrime#passi: Receive |STRENGTH|% Ability Strength for every enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range affected by <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Abilities/FireBa: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Abilities/EmberI: Protect Ember with flame armor that burns stronger over time, consuming energy once its meter is at full strength. Cast again to extinguish the flame.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Abilities/FireBl: Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Abilities/EmberI: Command a flaming comet to crash down in front of Ember, engulfing enemies with a fire that can spread through their ranks.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Ember#desc: Harness the power of fire. Ember’s heat deals high damage. She keeps a cool head when the battle is hot.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Ember#passive: Receive |STRENGTH|% Ability Strength for every enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range affected by <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/Dragon#desc: Unleash the draconic. Chroma employs Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Cold to deal high damage while maintaining survivability. Soar with winged fury.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/Dragon#passive: Wings sprout for an additional jump and bullet jump.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/Abilities/Drago: Exhale a deep breath of elemental destruction. Tap to cycle through elements, hold to cast. The chosen element applies to all of Chroma's abilities.
Depending on Chroma's elemental alignment, an offensive area-of-effect is created. Chroma and its nearby allies are imbued with defensive energy.

Chroma fortifies squad Armor when his Shields are damaged or he kills an enemy with a melee weapon. He increases squad Weapon Damage when he loses Health or he kills an enemy with a ranged weapon, double the effect on weak point kills.
Chroma turns his pelt into a massive sentry that strengthens nearby allies and engulfs enemies in elemental attacks.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/ChromaPrime#des: Bind the elements and unleash untold destruction with Chroma Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/ChromaPrime#pas: Wings sprout for an additional jump and bullet jump.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/GrendelPrime#: Primal. Insatiable. Grendel Prime devours all who oppose him.
Each enemy consumed grants |ARMOUR| bonus armor.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/Abilities/Dev: Swallow enemies whole and store them in Grendel's gut. Hold to vomit out stored enemies, covering them in toxic bile.

Regenerate health as Grendel absorbs nourishment from enemies in his gut. While he digests, enemies that attack or are attacked by Grendel suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage and energy sources provide more energy. These buffs extend to squad mates.
Grendel curls into a ball. He heals over time as he rolls, knocking over anyone in his path. Jumping slams Grendel into the ground and generates a damaging shockwave.
Violently puke out a bile soaked enemy from Grendel's gut, turning the consumed into a toxic projectile. Nearby enemies are slowed and have their armor dissolved by the bile.
