/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/Devourer#pass: Each enemy consumed grants |ARMOUR| bonus armor.
/Lotus/Powersuits/DemonFrame/DemonFrame#: To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.

Uriel commands, empowers, and protects three unique demons.

CATENACH: Snares and slows enemies chaining them together. Damage dealt to any target in the chain is inflicted on all snared enemies. (Unlocks with Infernalis)

GULPHAGOR : Latches onto foes dealing damage over time. If killed, a circle of pain is spawned. (Unlocks with Remedium)

VYTHELAS: Inscribes demonic runes upon fallen foes that add Fire Rate and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage when collected. (Unlocks with Demonium)
/Lotus/Powersuits/DemonFrame/Abilities/D:
Manifest an aura of flames inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect on nearby enemies.

Tap Dodge while airborne to take flight as a flaming meteor of destruction.
Uriel heals himself and his demons. If his demons are dead, they are resurrected.
Uriel rips out the souls of his demons, draining their health, and sends them in search of new victims. Souls explode on contact with an enemy, rendering it vulnerable to Damage.
Uriel and his demons create a growing ring of flaming brimstone. Charge the ability by utilizing demon abilities. Damage inflicted increases with each consecutive hit.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Dagath#desc: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Dagath#passive: There is a |PERCENT|% chance that Energy and Health Orbs will be |ENERGY|% more effective on Dagath.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Abilities/Dagat: Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.
Condemn nearby enemies to their doom. A portion of the damage Dagath deals is revisited upon them by a Wyrd Scythe. They also suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage.
Supercharge Dagath's weapons with extra Critical Damage. The effects are doubled on Doomed enemies. Escape fatal blows by briefly assuming a spectral form.
Phantom Kaithes charge forth, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage upon all in their path. Their attack strips the defenses of Doomed enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/MesaPrime#desc: Cast a long shadow with this lethal enforcer. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/MesaPrime#pass: Shoot dual-wielded sidearms |SPEED|% faster and reload single-handed sidearms |RELOAD|% more rapidly. Gain |HEALTH| Bonus Health when not using Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/Abilities/Ball: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/Abilities/Russ: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/Abilities/Rico: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/Abilities/GunF: With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/Cowgirl#desc: The gunslinger has a steady deadly hand. Each shot deals high damage. Mesa is the fastest draw in the realm.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/Cowgirl#passiv: Shoot dual-wielded sidearms |SPEED|% faster and reload single-handed sidearms |RELOAD|% more rapidly. Gain |HEALTH| Bonus Health when not using Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Powersuits/ConcreteFrame/Concrete: Albrecht Entrati designed Qorvex to protect a Chosen Operator from the unique hazards of his lab. A Crucible Core gives Qorvex high survivability as he provides crowd control.
Weapons wielded by Qorvex have an additional +|PUNCH_THROUGH| Punch Through.
/Lotus/Powersuits/ConcreteFrame/Abilitie: Summon a Chyrinka Pillar that slows enemies. It pulses <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
Contain the threat. Qorvex summons walls that slam together, damaging all enemies caught between them and inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status.

Guard yourself and nearby allies against Status Effects. Each time Qorvex kills or assists in killing an enemy affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status, the number of Status Effects Disometric Guard can prevent increases.

Release a beam from Qorvex's Crucible Core. Each enemy struck suffers <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. Enemies affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status explode in a chain reaction.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Choir#desc: Become enraptured by the song of devastation. Through her, the Jade Light can be a force of destruction or a source of support.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Choir#passive: Jade's profound understanding of the relationship between life and death grants her two Aura Mod Slots. Some of her Abilities apply Judgments, increasing enemy damage vulnerability by |CHANCE|% for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Abilities/ChoirP: Create a well of light that heals allies and hurts enemies. Those who enter the well will be highlighted by Judgments.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Abilities/ChoirC: Cycle through three songs that strengthen allies. Power of The Seven increases Ability Strength. Deathbringer increases Weapon Damage. Spirit of Resilience increases Shield Effectiveness. Extend the duration of each song by killing enemies surrounded by Judgments.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Abilities/ChoirE: Jade summons an accusatory gaze that slows nearby enemies and dissolves their Shields and Armor. When the gaze falls upon allies, they can be revived from a distance.
Soar with destructive power. Use alternate-fire to detonate Judgments, causing an explosion of Jade Light. Enemies inside the Light's Judgment radius empower the explosion.
/Lotus/Powersuits/BrokenFrame/XakuPrime#: The child of war and void is reborn in gold. That which was once shattered may rise stronger than that which was never broken.
|CHANCE|% Damage Reduction on AOE attacks and chance to avoid incoming weapon damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/BrokenFrame/Abilities/: Wield <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage for all attacks from equipped weapons when activated.

Void Tendrils steal weapons from nearby enemies to use as your own floating, auto-targeting armament. Damage output increases based on enemy level. The number of weapons grabbed also determines the damage multiplier for The Lost: Deny's Void beam.

Cycle through a trio of lost Warframe powers. Accuse manifests a Void fissure to corrupt enemies into allies. Gaze grasps targets in Void tendrils that capture damage and inflict it when the target is released. Deny annihilates with a beam of Void energy, wiping Sentient resistances.

Temporarily shed the outer pieces of Xaku in a destructive blast, then stalk the battlefield in a new, swifter skeletal form. Enemies damaged by the body shrapnel are rendered weaker to <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage. Xaku's other active abilities' duration is frozen in time and resumes once The Vast Untime expires.
/Lotus/Powersuits/BrokenFrame/BrokenFram: Broken Warframes adrift in the Void converged to create Xaku. Together, they deal high damage. Xaku proves that the sum of the whole is greater than its parts.
|CHANCE|% Damage Reduction on AOE attacks and chance to avoid incoming weapon damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/Brawler#desc: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/Brawler#passiv: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/Abilities/Braw: Bash enemies with an explosive sliding punch, repeat up to three times for a combo attack. Each hit in the three-punch combo increases the radius of the attack. Energy cost is reduced with each hit of Landslide. Install mods on the Landslide Fists to boost stats.
Summon a Bulwark rock-wall, activate again to send the rocks crashing toward the enemy. Bulwarks attacked by enemies release an area-of-effect Slash powered by the Health it has lost.
Atlas' hardened gaze will fossilize foes increasing the damage they take, heal Rumblers, and create Petrified Bulwarks. When shattered, petrified enemies drop healing Rubble for Atlas.
Summon two elemental stone brawlers to the melee. Summoning petrifies enemies in close proximity to Atlas. When finished, Rumblers collapse into a pile of healing Rubble.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPrime#des: In bygone ages, mountains were said to house warriors. In this age, the mountain has become the warrior.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPrime#pas: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/ValkyrPrime#: A proud fighter emerges unscarred by time or malice. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

Valkyr accumulates Rage when hitting or killing enemies with melee weapons, increasing her Melee Damage up to |PERCENT|%. Taking fatal damage when the Rage meter is above |CONSUME|% consumes the meter, preventing death and granting |DURATION|s of invulnerability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Abilities/Gr: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Abilities/Be: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Abilities/Sh: Unleash a damaging blast, slowing its victims while increasing their Melee Damage Vulnerability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Abilities/La: Valkyr bares her deadly claws, unleashing devastating attacks that also heal her. Valkyr becomes immune to Status Effects and her Armor bonus from Warcry is multiplied while using the claws.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Berserker#de: Valkyr was modified into a highly motivated and fearsome killer. She is adept at dealing damage and surviving. Her battle cry strikes terror into all who hear it.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Berserker#pa: Valkyr accumulates Rage when hitting or killing enemies with melee weapons, increasing her Melee Damage up to |PERCENT|%. Taking fatal damage when the Rage meter is above |CONSUME|% consumes the meter, preventing death and granting |DURATION|s of invulnerability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/OctaviaPrime#desc: Strike up a symphony of destruction with the mistress of music, Octavia, in her grandest and most spectacular form. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/OctaviaPrime#pass: Replenish |ENERGY| energy over |DURATION|s for Octavia and allies within |RANGE|m when abilities are activated.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/Abilities/BardMus: Rhythmically beats damage into nearby enemies and draws their fire. Damage inflicted on the Mallet increases its lethality.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/Abilities/BardCha: Launches a rollerball that charms foes to follow it. Combines with the Mallet to create a roving ball of sonic destruction.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/Abilities/BardJam: Grants buffs to those who consistently perform actions in time to Octavia's music. Timed jumps offer the Vivace speed buff. Crouching on the beat grants cloaking with the Nocturne buff. Firing rhythmically bestows Opera multishot buff. Timed melee swings give the Forte damage buff.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/Abilities/BardAmp: Draws power from the decibel level of sound in the area and uses it to amplify a damage buff for Octavia and her allies. It also doubles the damage and range of nearby Mallets.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/Bard#desc: Octavia turns bass, beat, and melody into a symphony of devastation. The music of her Mandachord gives her high survivability and supports allies. Her composition means the enemy’s destruction.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/Bard#passive: Replenish |ENERGY| energy over |DURATION|s for Octavia and allies within |RANGE|m when abilities are activated.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/BansheePrime#d: Banshee Prime assails her foes by manipulating sonic forces to deadly effect. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/BansheePrime#p: Weapon noises are hushed so that enemies cannot hear them.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Abilities/Push: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate or kill attackers.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Abilities/Sona: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak spots to everyone in your squad.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Abilities/Sile: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies and will limit their perceptions and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Abilities/Soni: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Banshee#desc: Banshee’s call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Banshee#passiv: Weapon noises are hushed so that enemies cannot hear them.
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/NovaPrime#d: Nova Prime wreaks devastation on her enemies using volatile antimatter. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/NovaPrime#p: Enemies killed while slowed down have |CHANCE|% to drop health orbs. Enemies killed while sped up have |CHANCE|% to drop energy orbs.
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/Abilities/N: Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/Abilities/A: Launch a large particle of charged antimatter that will detonate on contact. Direct the particle by aiming, shoot it to charge it further. Deals <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/Abilities/W: Creates a wormhole allowing instantaneous travel. Hold the ability to visualize placement.
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/Abilities/M: Primes all enemies in an expanding radius with volatile antimatter. Press the ability to slow down enemy movement, hold the ability to speed them up.
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/Anti#desc: Harness antimatter. Nova uses antiparticles to provide crowd control and amplify damage output. She obliterates enemies by destabilizing matter itself.
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/Anti#passiv: Enemies killed while slowed down have |CHANCE|% to drop health orbs. Enemies killed while sped up have |CHANCE|% to drop energy orbs.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/LavosPrime#d: Some Warframes were Prime from the start. Others ascended. Lavos, the master of transmutation, bowed to no one as he forged his own path to valor.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/LavosPrime#p:
Energy and Universal Orbs give Lavos status immunity for |DURATION|s.

Hold any ability to imbue the next cast with additional Elemental Damage and Status.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Abilities/Al:
Lash out with a toxic serpentine strike, consuming the target to heal Lavos.

Hold to imbue all abilities with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.

Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold.

Launch a probe that converts Health and Energy Orbs into Universal Orbs that provide both, and ammo pickups into Universal Ammo Pickups. The probe shocks enemies in close proximity. Each electrocuted foe reduces other ability cooldowns by 1.5s.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity.

Catalyst Probes erupt from Lavos and douse combatants in a fiery gel. Damage is doubled for each element afflicting an enemy.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Alchemist#de: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Alchemist#pa:
Energy and Universal Orbs give Lavos status immunity for |DURATION|s.

Hold any ability to imbue the next cast with additional Elemental Damage and Status.
/Lotus/Powersuits/EntratiMech/NechroTech: Nothing fancy but gets the job done and then some. With its electrified armor, this rough and ready mech can make the battlefield treacherous for the enemy with an arsenal of explosives.
/Lotus/Powersuits/EntratiMech/Abilities/: Hurl a canister of graviton fluids to create a wide mire that will significantly slow enemies traveling across it. Alternatively, the canister can be shot in mid-air to create a fiery conflagration.
Swathe the Necramech in a powerful electrical field that greatly enhances survivability in close combat. Enemies that strike the shroud will suffer for their impudence.
Launch a pattern of charged mines all around you. Each mine detonates in a violent blast when touched, damaging enemies in a three-meter radius.
Take a stationary stance to deploy maximum firepower and gain increased structural integrity for a time.
/Lotus/Powersuits/EntratiMech/ThanoTech#: This fearsome Necramech, fashioned in honor of the Entrati matriarch, is a robust front-line fighter. Favoring armor and health over shield strength, Bonewidow can grab and hurl enemies, deploy a heavy shield for personal defense, and cleave through opposing ranks with a massive warblade.
/Lotus/Powersuits/EntratiMech/Abilities/: Skewer and hold a target, siphoning their health. Use again to hurl the victim damaging them and anyone near the impact site.
Raise Bonewidow's shield to block incoming forward damage, reflecting it back at attackers. While active, bash enemies with a Maiden's Kiss.
Sweep surrounding enemies into the line of fire and suspend them in air with a force beam.
/Lotus/Powersuits/SiriusOrion/OrionSuit#: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.

Swapping between them grants |EFFICIENCY|% Ability Efficiency for the next |COUNT| casts.

When below 50 energy, Sirius & Orion will steal energy from each other.
/Lotus/Powersuits/SiriusOrion/Abilities/:
Repel enemies with Orion's sinister scythe, dealing <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage and Status Effect while reducing shields and armor.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Coronal Ejection.

Envelop Orion in an Astral Shell. Upon taking damage the shell becomes a decoy that draws fire until it's destroyed.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Jade Stars.

Orion forms a drifting black hole, trapping enemies within its gravity. Hitting the black hole with Gravitic Slash or Coronal Ejection will extend its duration and change its trajectory: Gravitic Slash will direct it away from Orion, and Coronal Ejection will pull it towards Sirius.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Light's Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Powersuits/PowersuitAbilities/Hel: Increase the efficiency of your ammo consumption.
Heal your companion and call it to your side.
Consume Energy to heal yourself and grant matching Energy to each ally.
Automatically succeed at your next hack attempt.

Emit a pulse that adds stacks to Status Effects already afflicting enemies. The damage of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin effects, excluding those created by Sickening Pulse itself, are added together to create a new instance of the Effect with a refreshed timer
Grant yourself immunity to Status effects.
Sacrifice Shields to reinforce Armor for a period of time.
Condense all <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Status Effects into a single damage instance.
Increase the strength of your next ability use.
Stun an enemy; a portion of the next damage you deal to it will be dealt to all enemies around it.
Send out a short-lived Void Spark that is drawn toward the nearest Medallion, Ayatan Sculpture, rare crate, unscanned Kuria or unscanned Fragment.
/Lotus/Weapons/VoidTrader/VTDetron#desc: For Orokin-era smugglers, this fearsome handheld shotgun was a favored tool for 'dispute resolution'.
/Lotus/Weapons/VoidTrader/PrismaSkana#de: Forged from raw prisma crystals and infused with Void energy, this blade's pristine edge is honed razor-sharp to eviscerate even the most deadly of foes.
/Lotus/Weapons/VoidTrader/PrismaGrakata#: Encased in plates refined from pure prisma crystals, this rare element gives this assault rifle a radiant luster.
/Lotus/Weapons/Thanotech/ThanoRifle/Than: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy, oversized automatic rifle with withering fire that delivers rapid heat damage. Secondary fire unleashes an arcing projectile that ricochets off surfaces and enemies, exploding on every impact.
/Lotus/Weapons/Thanotech/ThanoPistol/Tha: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. This large, weighty double-barreled pistol delivers twin projectiles that pack a punch, exploding on impact. Secondary fire puts the weapon in lock-on mode. Aim to lock onto multiple targets, then fire to unleash homing projectiles.
/Lotus/Weapons/Thanotech/EntratiWristGun: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this weapon. In Incarnon form, draw in ambient power to deal steadily increased damage to enemies. At full power, release a blast of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
/Lotus/Weapons/Thanotech/EntSphereHammer: Wield the timeless power of this mighty hammer. Heavy Attacks performed with Ekhein temporarily increase its Damage and Attack Speed.
/Lotus/Weapons/Thanotech/EntFistIncarnon: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this fist weapon. In Incarnon form, perform Heavy Slams to impale nearby enemies with spikes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Zariman/Pistols/Hea: During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau. There would be no such celebration, but the Void imbued the Laetum with a much more explosive capacity.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Zariman/Melee/Tonfa: Orokin elites admired farmers in conquered regions, because they had learned to fight with modified farming tools despite being forbidden to own weapons. For their voyage, the Zariman were presented with Praedos in recognition of Zariman tenacity. The Void reinforces the strength of the spirited individual by fortifying the Praedos.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Zariman/Melee/Heavy: The Thalys played a ceremonial role in the Zariman harvest festival, and was intended to reap the first fruits of Tau. Now twisted from this purpose, it plants Void shards in enemy flesh instead. Each new shard planted causes existing shards to inflict damage on their hosts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Zariman/Melee/Dagge: In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies that ideal. Void energy strengthens Innodem gliding aerial attacks and the wielder is increasingly resilient as they perform finisher attacks in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Zariman/LongGuns/Se: Zariman colonists originally intended to use the Phenmor in burial rites. In Orokin society, the higher the rank, the greater number of volleys for the deceased. Its stock is carved from Phenaureus Pine, a tree designed to release seedlings only onto scorched earth. In the hands of the Void, the Phenmor becomes darkly aggressive.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Zariman/LongGuns/Pu: The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/Ten: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/Sta: Used by The Stalker, Despair throwing blades have a mono-filament edge, sharp enough to penetrate a Warframe.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/Kun: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/U18: The claws of these tactical bombs dig into the target and detonate on command.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/TnO: Go on the hunt with Oraxia’s signature secondary. Fling a volley of toxin-laced barbs, or drop a cluster snare that scatters on impact, seizing nearby enemies and dragging them together.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/TnC:
In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Cantare's blades lodge into the battlefield and return upon reload. When returning blades strike enemies, Cantare empowers allies with increased Reload Speed.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/Sti: The remotely triggered Castanas quietly deliver a lethal dose of electricity to unsuspecting enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/Pri: As deadly as any bullet without the associated noise or commotion.
These rare, braided throwing daggers were a favorite tool of high ranking Orokin assassins.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/LiD: A flash of red ribbon is the last thing most victims of these throwing-daggers see.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/Gla: Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/ShotgunVand: A different take on a familiar shotgun, the Strun Wraith features unique styling.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/Shotgun#des: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/QuadShotgun: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/PrimeBoar#d: One of the finest examples of Tenno craftsmanship, the Boar Prime offers a higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and a much higher per-shot damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/FullAutoSho: A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/DoubleBarre: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/VandalSniperR: A customized version of the elusive Snipetron, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/VIPRifle#desc: A special version of the standard Braton rifle with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher accuracy and damage values. The Braton Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/TennoSniperRi: A classic Tenno sniper rifle, the Vectis is ideal for ranged takedowns.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/TennoAR#desc: Accuracy coupled with a massive magazine makes the Soma assault rifle a formidable weapon.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/StartingRifle: The MK1-Braton is the standard issue rifle for all Tenno. A versatile weapon that can be customized to support a wide variety of play styles.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/SniperRifle#d: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/SemiAutoRifle: The Latron is a highly efficient rifle that performs well at medium and at long range, its accuracy making it a deadly weapon in the hands of skilled marksmen.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/Rifle#desc: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/LatronPrime#d: The ornamental Latron Prime exploits ancient Orokin technology to get a slight damage increase over the standard Latron.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/HeavyRifle#de: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/BurstRifle#de: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/BratonPrime#d: A classic Orokin weapon, Braton Prime features modified damage levels and a larger magazine over the standard model.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/BoltoRifle#de: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistols/TnYareliPis: Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistols/TnWraitheSi: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/DualKamas/Dua: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/DualDagger/Fa: A set of ceremonial daggers from the Orokin era, the Fang Prime's blades resonate violently as they strike. This allows them to pierce hardened materials like armor with ease.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/DualDagger/Du: A shorter version of the Ether blade that allows for a more focused attack on a single target.
These matching stilettos have increased attack speed and can unleash a flurry of multi-hit attacks.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Dagger/DarkDa: This short blade weapon forged using dark metals has limited range but comes out fast.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Dagger/Dagger: This short blade weapon has limited range but comes out fast and can inflict fire damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Dagger/Cerami: This short blade weapon was built using ceramic. It has limited range but comes out fast.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/CronusSword/P: The Dakra Prime is a Tenno forged weapon, crafted during the time of the Orokin. It is renowned for speed, power and the ability to hit multiple targets.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/CronusSword/C: A strong blade forged using ceramic.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Claws/TennoCl: Utilizing a new fighting stance, this Tenno weapon turns fists into claws and enemies into messy piles of meat and scrap metal.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/BrassKnuckles: These coverings for the hands and feet allow devastating high flying hand-to-hand combat attacks without risking harm to the user.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/WolfFrame: Mete out the sharp pain of justice. Heavy Slam attacks create a vortex that pulls in lifted enemies when the Sarofang’s Combo Multiplier builds to 8x. In Voruna’s hands, the Sarofang only requires a 5x Combo Multiplier to summon the vortex.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/PrimeVoru: Voruna Prime's signature axe is adorned with Orokin gold. She personally ensured that the former owners would have no further use for it.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/DualInfes: The fast and brutal Dual Ichor axes will quickly tear through enemies with a high probability of inflicting Critical Damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/DualAxeWe: Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/AxeWeapon: The Scindo is a heavy war axe crafted by the Tenno. Reduced speed and agility is balanced by heavy, devastating strikes capable of connecting with multiple targets at once.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/PrimeZore: Axes worthy of an executioner, refined to Orokin perfection.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/PrimeScin: An ancient executioners weapon, the honor of decapitation by the Scindo Prime was reserved for the Orokin's most respected enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/WraithLatr: The Latron Wraith is a powerful variation of the standard, semi-automatic rifle that features unique styling.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnoPrmryXb: Quickly fire off a volley of deadly bolts with the Attica repeating crossbow.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnoLotusPo: An energy projectile bursts forth from the Steflos and grows as it rushes toward enemies. The projectile's duration increases when it hits an enemy. When Citrine fires the Steflos, its projectile speed increases.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnoLeverAc: This Tenno crafted, lever action rifle, is equal parts elegance and executioner.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnWispRifl: Strike with silent lightning or the pummeling drum of thunder. Alternate between stealthy short-range electrical discharge, and automatic lightning gun. Faster mode-switch when used by Wisp.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnSMG/TnSM: Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnRifleErs: This unusual automatic rifle feels strangely familiar and has two fire modes. Primary fire packs radiation damage. Alternate fire charges up to launch an explosive projectile.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnRevolver: Precise calibration, rapid trigger-pull and a steady hand all combine to bring down the hardiest prey on two legs or four.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnRailjack: The Quellor was standard-issue to Dax Railjack crews of the Old War, dating back to the earliest, pre-Sigma craft. A rapid-fire assault rifle with a hefty magazine-size, the Quellor is an all-round workhorse. Also capable of large, short-range cryo-blasts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnQuadSnip: Like a breath of wind, shots fired by this multi-barrel sniper are felt but never seen by its targets. Headshots in quick succession increase the Perigale's ammo efficiency. When the Perigale is wielded by Voruna, its ammo pool increases.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnPriestSp: Blast targets with corrosive plasma projectiles, or toss the scepter to inflict an energy field upon nearby enemies that amplifies their brain waves to attract bullets.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnModQuest: A sturdy burst-rifle of considerable age and unknown origin collected by Teshin during his many years wandering the Origin System.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnInkRifle: Turn the enemy's worst nightmare into reality with Follie's signature rifle. The Enkaus will instantly kill and dissolve inked enemies that are damaged at low health. Shooting inked enemies siphons ink back into the Enkaus, allowing for a constant flow of creative destruction.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnHopliteS: Styanax’s speargun matches his might. Throw Afentis to pin an enemy and nearby enemies will also be stunned. Throw Afentis onto the ground to buff nearby allies with Ballistarii Might. The buff increases reload speed, fire rate, and ammo pools and reduces recoil. Allies who kill enemies with Ballistarii Might maintain the buff temporarily when they move away from Afentis.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnHeavySho: Deliver a massive punch with each blast of this shotgun, or launch a round that explodes mid-air knocking down nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnGlassSho: Blast enemies with glass slugs that devastate on impact. In Gara's hands, this signature weapon has a larger Ammo Pool.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnBeltFedR: Cyte-09's signature rifle is an ideal match for forceful gunners. A precisely timed reload increases reload speed and infuses the new magazine with Heat Damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnBardRifl: Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. When Octavia wields her signature rifle alt-fire Headshot Kills have a chance to instantly refill the magazine.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnAlchemis: Launch a glaive that ricochets off surfaces in bursts of elemental damage, then perforate enemies with primary fire’s precision buck-shot. Damage increases with each Status Effect afflicting a target. Lavos will transmute a small portion of any ammo pickup to Primary Ammo when wielding his signature Cedo.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TennoTommy: A high-capacity, high-damage enforcer, this weapon can switch between the high crit semi-automatic and full automatic firing modes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/SapientPri: Using a barrage of rapid-fire plasma rockets, Gauss’ signature weapon lays down a path of destruction. Reloads are faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. For safety, rockets arm after traveling a safe distance.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/RubicoPrim: For the hunter, the apex of the sniper's art. For the hunted, a gateway to the next life.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/RevenantSh: Irradiate enemies with a continuous stream of deadly plasma. Charging secondary fire releases a glob of plasma that erupts with homing bomblets on impact. Increased Magazine Capacity when wielded by Revenant.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/RepeatingC: This devastating automatic crossbow is the perfect marriage of ancient Earth weaponry and Tenno technology.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeZhuge: Tenno artistry. Ancient craft. A weapon of surgical precision and devastating effect. Each bolt fired by Zhuge Prime explodes shortly after embedding.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeVecti: Once thought destroyed, the newly uncovered Vectis Prime revives Tenno martial traditions.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTrumn: Sleek lines and golden accents define this masterpiece of the illustrious Entrati family.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTigri: An artifact of exquisite beauty. A weapon of deadly purpose.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTiber: Art meets ingenuity with this beautifully deadly rifle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTenor: Add lethal staccato percussion to Octavia's melodies with this masterpiece assault rifle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeSybar: Sleek and slender, a golden symbol of Tenno perfection.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeStrun: A classic shotgun design, embellished for the elite as only the Orokin could.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeStrad: Between measured staccato and staggering crescendo, Stradavar Prime never fails to call down a devastating finale.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeSoma/: Known for taking down whole squads with its single massive magazine, few weapons were as feared as the Prime Soma.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeScour: Smite the unrighteous with Harrow Prime's signature speargun.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimePhant: Phantasma Prime is burnished with deadly force. In Revenant’s hands, it has increased magazine capacity. The might of its irradiated plasma is reminiscent of the fearsome Eidolon.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimePerig: The one who exalted Voruna to her Prime form imbued her signature sniper rifle with increased magazine size and ammo capacity, as if to arm her for a long hunt.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimePanth: The max-velocity saw-launcher perfected. Features a larger magazine, faster fire rate, and a radial, slashing ricochet.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeNagan: A golden version of Garuda's versatile crossbow, as fashioned by the Orokin's finest weaponsmiths. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshot kills have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda the Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeLight: Caliban Prime's signature sniper rifle is no mere ceremonial weapon. A sign, perhaps, that peace between Orokin and Sentient was destined to be fleeting. Struck enemies become lightning rods, with a chance to attract bolts of chain lightning that can jump to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeFulmi: Wield a storm. Fulmin Prime's electric rounds switch between lightning beams and short-range bursts. Wisp quickly swaps between each mode with her elemental prowess.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeCorin: Heavy in the hand with a bone-crunching kickback. This Prime version of this shotgun adds remote detonation of the weapon's airburst round.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeCedo/: A golden shotgun, forged for those who deliver judgment.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeBurst: Once thought lost to the ages, attempts to reengineer the Burston Prime never fully replicated this weapon's power and agility.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeBolto: Fires Orokin designed bolts that are faster and sharper.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeBaza/: This rapid-fire classic is the Orokin-engineered definition of silent, pinpoint lethality.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAstil: Loose explosive glass slugs that tear through enemies with Gara’s signature shotgun, presented here in its spectacular Prime form.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAlter: Orokin gold enhances the conductivity of Gyre Prime's signature rifle, enabling it to fire massive electrifying orbs.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAfent: The gilded speargun of Styanax Prime shines like a beacon across the battlefield, invigorating allies and stunning enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAccel: Engage your enemies with deadly speed. This weapon reloads even faster when its wielder sprints, faster still with Gauss.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PaxDuviric: Kullervo's signature weapon boasts melee synergy. Every shot that lands increases the wielder's Melee Combo count. When Kullervo wields Rauta, it also increases his Melee Combo duration.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/Miter/TnoM: Firing high-velocity blades, this weapon can also be used as a battle-saw, shredding anything unfortunate enough to get within range.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/LoginPrima: Deploy the radar disc to reveal hidden enemies and then strike with precision shots that punch through all obstacles in the way.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/GyreRifle/: Gyre's signature weapon has two fire modes. Primary fire shocks enemies with electrical orbs. Alternate fire is a large ball of electricity that sticks to any surface and pulses <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity before it explodes. In Gyre's hands, the weapon has a small amount of multishot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/Gunbrella/: Depend on Higasa when it rains bullets. Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/GarudaCros: Slash targets with a single precise bolt from Garuda's signature crossbow. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshots have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/FiveShotSn: Scope out the enemy with this long-range revolver style rifle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/DrakeRifle: Forged by a master gunsmith, this Tenno burst rifle will strike down targets with swift precision.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/DoubleBarr: The double-barreled Tigris shotgun fires two bursts in rapid succession, easily taking down the toughest prey.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/DexTheThir: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the third anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Grimoire/TnGrimoire: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Grimoire/TnDoppelga: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/StalkerBow#des: Dread is the calling card of The Stalker. It fires arrows that can decapitate.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeHuntingBo: Discovered deep inside an ancient Orokin derelict, the Paris Prime increases the kinetic energy of any bolt it fires, dealing more damage than its more common counterpart.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/HuntingBow#des: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/TnChoirBow/TnC:
Counter the dread of battle with a song of praise. Enemies cannot hurt your allies while wounded by Evensong's arrows. Kills with Evensong empower ally weapons with Multishot.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeDerelictC: Each arrow spawns a swarm of sticky appendages on impact. These tongue-like probes latch onto nearby unfortunates and drag them close before bursting into a mess of diseased goo.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeDaikyu/Pr: Long believed lost, the mighty Daikyu Prime was the pride of many a Tenno dojo. Designed to strike the foe where they are weakest, its powerful shots repay careful marksmanship.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeCernos/Pr: A noble bow to hunt hellish beasts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/Omicrus/Omicru: Hunhow’s gift, carved from the bones of his kin. Shots can be charged and held; release them just before full charge for maximum effect.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/DaxDuviriAsyme: The versatile Cinta can fire arrows in quick succession, quickly charge a shock wave, or fully charge a powerful focused shot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/AsymetricalBow: Daikyu takes great strength to draw back, but provides added power and range to every shot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/AntlerBow/Antl: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bayonet/TnBayonetRi: Bring hell to the battlefield with Uriel's signature rifle and bayonet combination. Occupying both primary and melee slots, this unique weapon blends precision marksmanship with unrelenting melee combat.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Tn: From death blooms the Larkspur. A unique and menacing Archgun with a wild initial attack that locks onto a target then chains other targets close to the first. It also sports an explosive projectile mode. In Hildryn's grip the Larkspur carries more reserve ammo.

Mandonel fires <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage projectiles. Partially charged shots release a spread and fully charged shots release a beam that dissolves into a radiation field. Projectiles that pass through the field are empowered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th: Blast through enemies with a double-barreled shot of energized slugs. This siphons their life essence which is then used to generate the secondary fire's massive air-burst mortar. The ancient Entrati weapon was built for Necramechs but also functions as an Archgun.

An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati for use by their Necramechs. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. Punishing automatic primary fire and a secondary mode that charges up to unleash a destructive beam of energy with a large explosion at point of impact.

An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati for use by their Necramechs. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy flamethrower with surprising range. Secondary fire launches three projectiles in a fan pattern that explode, leaving a damaging area of effect for a short duration.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ro: An Archwing energy weapon that sends waves of deadly plasma crashing into enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Re: Shatter your targets with explosive shells from this devastating Archwing cannon.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ra: When fully charged, the magnetized barrel of the Velocitus accelerates a metal slug to tremendous speeds, piercing hulls and obliterating armor.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Pr: Embrace pandemonium. Chainfire and explosive potential meet in Larkspur Prime. Hildryn packs more ammo when she wields this mighty weapon.
Flaunting ceremonial beauty, this arch gun flak cannon is even more devastating than its standard issue counterpart.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/No: Nokko’s signature archgun fires six homing missiles, each bearing a payload of one of the six combined elements which detonate in an area upon impact.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/La: When fully charged, this flak cannon delivers a devastating shot. Perfect for taking down fast-moving interceptors.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Fo: The Imperator Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the barrel.
A long range rifle capable of firing in space, the Imperator's versatility makes it an ideal weapon for space combat.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar: Delivering twin streams of highly accurate, rapid-fire ordnance, the Decurion are specifically designed for combat in the vacuum of space.

Colder than space and less forgiving, Prisma crystals bring elite efficiency to the already sleek Dual Decurion. Requiring the lightest of touches to reload, these twin archguns prove that heavy weaponry can still possess elegance.
Devastate free-space enemies with Phaedra, the Soma's big-sister.
Unload deadly accurate bursts of mayhem.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Void: A rare object of beauty, this Archwing sword has been sheathed in prisma crystal and baptized in the Void’s energy.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/GrnA: Gallium-alloy gauntlets for close-range Archwing combat. Designed by the infamous Tyl Regor.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Exal: Heavy attacks briefly transform the Corufell into a Gunblade. After the Gunblade fires, the Corufell returns to its Heavy Scythe state. Its transformation is fastest in Citrine's hands.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch: Part sword, part shield, the Centaur excels at charging headlong into enemy fire.
Weightless space turns this impossibly massive sword into an agile instrument of destruction.
This laser bladed battle-axe easily hacks through a ship's defenses and the forces protecting it.
Tear apart incoming enemies with this massive hooked blade.
Become an angel of death, with this Archwing scythe.
Using Archwing's jets for thrust, this massive hammer crushes anything in its path.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/PrimeAkimboS: Used together, these Orokin pistols feed off each other, inflicting greater damage with an enhanced status chance for inducing elemental effects on targets.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/DualVastos#d: Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/DualMagnusPr: Fill your fists with golden cannons of fury. This refined design unlocks quicker handling and higher critical chance.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/DualMagnus#d: Twice the ammo and twice the stopping power of a single Magnus.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboViperP: A Viper equipped in each hand.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboShotGu: A Bronco equipped in each hand.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboPistol: A Lato equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and Fire Rate, but Reload time is doubled and Accuracy is lowered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboBolto#: A Bolto equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but reload time is doubled and accuracy is lowered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboAutoPi: Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkLexPrimePi: Savage the enemy with a Lex Prime in each hand.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkLexPistols: Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/: Taken from defeated Grineer commanders and rebuilt to improve combat efficiency and reliability.
Justice blinds. Block hits to charge a Radial Blind, when fully charged Block+Heavy Attack to unleash it.
Forged in the fires of rebel struggle, this shotgun is a force for liberation.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Pistol: This modified ballistica is the weapon of choice used by Red Veil Assassins to take out high-priority marks.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Melee/: Infiltrate undetected; reduced visibility when held. Then strike with confidence; hits to irradiated targets restores shields and creates overshields.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Bows/R: A finely tuned instrument of assassination.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence: The favored side-arms of Perrin Sequence executives, these pistols have been modified to improve efficiency and killing potential.
Whip the enemy out of their ill-gotten gains; double credit drops on kills.
Ruthless and efficient, just like the free-market.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/Pistol: This remotely detonated electrical trap is used by devotees of New Loka to protect their temples and shrines.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/Melee/: Each charged attack turns the enemy’s pain into a healing pulse that washes over allies. Also, creates resistance to Status Effects when held.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/LongGu: Echo nature's violent beauty with this special Tigris.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/P: Deployed by the Cephalon Suda, once a data-analyzing instrument the Gammacor main focus is defense.
Designed to quickly vaporize minerals for content analysis, users discovered its powerful beam was equally efficient at dispatching hostiles.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/M: This intelligent hammer takes an enemy killed by a Heavy Attack and recomposes them as an ally. Any fatal strike with this weapon also performs a Codex scan.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/L: Cephalon Suda's custom issue Simulor was built to satisfy her curiosity.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi: For the Arbiters of Hexis these pistols are more than simple weapons, they are symbols of truth and discipline.
Spinning attacks unleash the Stormpath, a tempest of mayhem that hurls any foes in its way.
Bring down judgement, with this boltor crafted by the Arbiters of Hexis.
/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/Shedu/SheduHeav: This arm-cannon, ripped from a Sentient, rapid-fires thermal pulses that explode in an electrical blast. Features an ammo-less quick charge capacitor, that emits a knock-back pulse and strips Sentient damage resistances when fully discharged.
/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/SentRifleNewWar: This Sentient war instrument can either barrage targets with explosive bolts or draw on its regenerative battery to create twin plasma beams that chain through targets. When fully drained, Health is leeched from nearby foes for a short period.
/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/SentOctaMiniGun: Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/SentJointedScyt: Caliban’s signature scythe, forged from a limb wrenched off a fallen Eidolon centuries ago. 50% increased Melee Combo Counter Chance when wielded by Caliban.
/Lotus/Weapons/Orokin/BallasSword/Ballas: The Sentient slayer. An offering from Ballas.
/Lotus/Weapons/Operator/Pistols/DrifterP: A silent, pistol-style Amp for the Drifter. Generates its own ammunition from Void energy. A precisely timed reload over-charges the next shot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Operator/Melee/DrifterTaz: An electrified jolter for quick melee takedowns, assembled from scavenged scrap. Ideal for use on unsuspecting opponents.
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Strun#desc: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Paris#desc: The MK1-Paris is the standard issue bow for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Kunai#desc: The MK1-Kunai is the standard issue throwing knives for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Furis#desc: The MK1-Furis are the standard issue automatic pistol for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Furax#desc: The MK1-Furax is the standard issue fist weapon for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Bo#desc: The MK1-Bo is the standard issue staff weapon for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasSilencedPistol/: A true masterpiece of Höllvanian engineering, Vesper 77's advanced laser sight highlights enemy Weak Points with precision. Aim to increase its Critical Damage Multiplier.
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGrenadeLauncher: Put them down so that they stay down, with this Scaldra slug launcher.
